items.name: Carbon
items.desc:
The building block of all organic life. Of critical importance to space travellers, as Carbon is used to recharge mining equipment.
The Mining Laser will harvest Carbon from trees, plants, and all other forms of vegetable.

items.name: Condensed Carbon
items.desc:
Advanced material, processed from regular carbon in a Refiner.
The increased molecule density offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio.
Occasionally found in crystalline form. Harvesting large crystals may require a Advanced Mining Laser.

items.name: Oxygen
items.desc:
Integral to the atmospheric filtering technology at the heart of the exosuit life support system.
Exosuit material processing allows oxygen to be harvested directly from appropriate planetary flora.
Other plantlife may be scanned with the Analysis Visor to reveal alternative oxygen supplies.

items.name: Hexite
items.desc: An odourless, mineral-rich substance with a hexagonal crystalline structure, harvested from the faecal matter of a creature.

items.name: Di-hydrogen
items.desc:
A stable, crystalline form of hydrogen remarkable both for its extreme energy density and its stability at atmospheric pressures.
Common to all worlds, Di-hydrogen is found in the form of large blue crystals. It is a key component of Starship Launch Fuel.

items.name: Deuterium
items.desc:
A stable hydrogen isotope used heavily in both small-scale fusion reactors and neutron-scattering shield technology.
Deuterium very rarely occurs naturally. Most of the galaxy's supply comes from the processing of Di-hydrogen and Tritium in Refiners.

items.name: Tritium
items.desc:
Radioactive isotope commonly used to fuel the fusion reactor at the heart of starship Pulse Engines.
Abundant in interstellar asteroid fields, Tritium can be mined from asteroids using starship weaponry. Scan (SCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.

items.name: Ferrite Dust
items.desc:
An abundant mineral element, found in rock formations and other areas of geological interest. Easily extracted using a Mining Laser.
Typically requires processing in a Refiner before use in construction or technology manufacture.

items.name: Pure Ferrite
items.desc:
Processed metal, free of dust and pebbles. Used to construct a wide variety of structures and technologies.
Typically purified from Ferrite dust using a Refiner, but can occasionally be found in large deposits. Collection may require an Advanced Mining Laser.

items.name: Magnetised Ferrite
items.desc:
Highly processed metal, requiring several stages of processing in a Refiner.
Used in the creation of advanced structures and technologies. Avoid ingestion.

items.name: Silicate Powder
items.desc:
An abundant mineral element, found within the geological strata of all rocky worlds. Easily extracted using a Terrain Manipulator. Create a tunnel anywhere to begin extraction.
Process in a Refiner to create Glass.

items.name: Sodium
items.desc:
A powerful catalyst, useful for charging defensive technologies such as shields or hazard protection.
Exosuit material handling technology allows automatic harvesting from appropriate <CATALYSTsodium-rich flora.
A vital ingredient in the creation of many advanced devices, products and components.

items.name: Sodium Nitrate
items.desc:
An advanced catalyst, useful for charging defensive technologies such as shields or hazard protection.
Created in a Refiner, or occasionally found in crystalline form on a planet's surface.
Offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio over regular Sodium.

items.name: Cobalt
items.desc:
Mined from underground minerals, cobalt is found in plentiful supply in caves and caverns. Useful in the manufacture of Ion Batteries.
It is used in the creation of several technologies and structures, and can be processed in a Refiner to make the most of its inherent charge.

items.name: Ionised Cobalt
items.desc:
A highly energised form of Cobalt, this processed metal can be used to create Advanced Ion Batteries, a conveniently portable source of energy for the Exosuit.
In widespread use as a key component in the creation of advanced technologies and structures.

items.name: Salt
items.desc:
A naturally occuring salt, found in abundance in underwater minerals.
Can be processed in a Refiner to create Chlorine. This refined form is used in the manufacture of advanced products and technologies.

items.name: Chlorine
items.desc:
A reactive element most easily harvested by processing the salt-infused minerals found in oceans.
Used in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.name: Cyto-Phosphate
items.desc:
A blue-green organic compound produced during the metabolic cycle of deep-sea plantlife. Rich in soluble energy, cyto-phosphates are crucial in many submarine technologies.
The Mining Laser will harvest cyto-phosphate compounds from underwater flora.

items.name: Copper
items.desc:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.
Copper is found on planets orbiting yellow stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.name: Cadmium
items.desc:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.
Cadmium is found on planets orbiting red stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.name: Emeril
items.desc:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.
Emeril is found on planets orbiting green stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.name: Indium
items.desc:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.
Indium is found on planets orbiting blue stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.name: Chromatic Metal
items.desc:
A processed metal alloy, created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium.
The rarer the stellar metal, the more Chromatic Metal it will produce.
This valuable metal is used in the creation of many advanced technologies.

items.name: Paraffinium
items.desc:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Typically found on planets with a tropical environment.

items.name: Pyrite
items.desc:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Typically found on planets with a desert environment.

items.name: Ammonia
items.desc:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Typically found on planets with a toxic environment.

items.name: Uranium
items.desc:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Typically found on planets with a radioactive environment.

items.name: Dioxite
items.desc:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Typically found on planets with a frozen environment.

items.name: Phosphorus
items.desc:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Typically found on planets with a scorched environment.

items.name: Mordite
items.desc:
Despite much study, little is known about this haunting, crystalline compound.
It is released from the cadavers of dying creatures, but can also be specifically cultivated and harvested from the Mordite Root plant.

items.name: Pugneum
items.desc:
This oily, unsettling liquid leaks from the circuitry of Sentinels.
Prized by the Vy'keen, Pugneum is thought to share some essential properties with Nanites. It hums in a sinister fashion upon contact with organic matter.

items.name: Silver
items.desc:
Valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.
Prized by people in all systems for its lustre and shine.

items.name: Gold
items.desc:
Highly valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.
Universally prized for its beauty and versatility.

items.name: Platinum
items.desc:
Extremely valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.
Universally prized for its hardiness and versatility.

items.name: Sulphurine
items.desc:
A pungent atmospheric gas. High concentrations are extremely hazardous to organic life.
With the aid of specialised machinery, can be extracted from the atmospheres of Scorched and Desert planets.

items.name: Radon
items.desc:
A colourless, odourless gas with a relatively short half-life.
Found in both Radioactive and Frozen atmospheres, this gas is produced by the decay of other high-energy elements.

items.name: Nitrogen
items.desc:
A reactive atmospheric gas found wherever there is organic life.
Nitrogen is readily harvested from the atmospheres of Lush and Toxic planets.

items.name: Activated Copper
items.desc:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.
This Copper has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.
Copper is found on planets orbiting yellow stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

items.name: Activated Cadmium
items.desc:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.
This Cadmium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.
Cadmium is found on planets orbiting red stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

items.name: Activated Emeril
items.desc:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.
This Emeril has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.
Emeril is found on planets orbiting green stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

items.name: Activated Indium
items.desc:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.
Indium is found on planets orbiting blue stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.
This Indium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

items.name: Fungal Mould
items.desc:
An oddly-glowing substance, harvested from the gills of Fungal Clusters.
The host plant requires a toxic climate to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.name: Frost Crystal
items.desc:
A beautiful blue crystal, this organic compound possesses both great hardiness and a shimmering translucence. It is harvested from the leaves of Frostwort.
Frostwort requires frozen conditions to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.name: Gamma Root
items.desc:
A strange substance that seems to slowly shift the air around it. It is found in the roots of the Gamma Weed plant.
Gamma Weed requires high background radiation to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.name: Cactus Flesh
items.desc:
Succulent, edible cactus flesh from the Echinocactus plant. As well as being juicy on the tongue, the flesh has many industrial uses.
The Echinocactus thrives only on desert planets, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray..

items.name: Solanium
items.desc:
A powerful chemical that has resisted attempts at synthesis. It can be harvested from the bark of the Solar Vine.
The vine requires a hot climate to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.name: Star Bulb
items.desc:
A beautiful gemstone, this prized product is the engorged, luminescent berry of the Star Bramble.
The host plant requires lush conditions to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.name: Marrow Bulb
items.desc:
A glowing organic bulb, harvested from the Cave Marrow plant found growing underground.
The Cave Marrow has proved resistant to domestication, and no farmable cultivars are known to exist. As such, marrow bulbs must be harvested by hand in the wild.

items.name: Kelp Sac
items.desc:
A rubbery, luminescent sac harvested from underwater Candle Kelp plants.
Agricultural science has not yet tamed the Candle Kelp. As such, these sacs cannot be farmed.

items.name: Faecium
items.desc:
A foul-smelling compound that can be harvested from the Gutrot Flower, or less desirably from the faecal matter of some species.
Creatures can be fed to encourage the formation and deposition of faecium crystals.

items.name: Residual Goop
items.desc:
A pulsating, foul smelling goop that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.
Skin contact is not advised.

items.name: Runaway Mould
items.desc:
An out of control mould growth that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.
Likely to be several different species of mould, merged together into one super-colony.

items.name: Rusted Metal
items.desc:
Handfuls of corroded metal, distorted by years of exposure to the harsh environment.
Handle with care.

items.name: Living Slime
items.desc:
A heavy, oozing slime. It is moving gently, as if it has a heartbeat of its own.
Nutrient source: unknown.

items.name: Viscous Fluids
items.desc:
An unnaturally thick liquid of dubious colour. Its origins are impossible to fathom.
Appears to have some mild magnetic properties.

items.name: Nanite Cluster
items.desc:
A dense miasma of Nanites, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter.
Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.

items.name: QUICKSILVER
items.desc: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

items.name: UNITS
items.desc: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

items.name: Liquid Sun
items.desc:
Conventional planetary metal, superheated and then held in a stabilised plasmatic form.
Extracted from metallic terrain deposits using a Solar Ray. Enormously energetic.

items.name: Fragmented Qualia
items.desc:
A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into the surface of a tiny metallic shard. This fragment of data represents a recording of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.
Generated by the interaction of the Animus Beam with a living target.

items.name: Basalt
items.desc:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Typically found on planets with a volcanic environment.

items.name: Tainted Metal
items.desc:
Shredded fragments of a soft, grey metal. Its surface is porous, and when touched it oozes ever-so-slightly.
Found in the creaking wreck of a derelict freighter. The space station Scrap Dealer may find this interesting...

items.name: MERCHANTS
items.desc: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

items.name: EXPLORERS
items.desc: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

items.name: MERCENARIES
items.desc: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

items.name: Standing Increased: Gek
items.desc: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

items.name: Standing Increased: Korvax
items.desc: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

items.name: Standing Increased: Vy'keen
items.desc: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

items.name: Cursed Dust
items.desc:
A powdery desert soil, slick with the gland expressions of a colossal sandworm. Historically, some have regarded this dust as the divine parent of such worms. It smells curiously sweet.
Cursed Dust gathers in the terrain deposits of planets blighted by titan worm activity.

items.name: Somnal Dust
items.desc:
Grey, dead, sparkling with life and colour, singing as it shimmers. This impossibly fine dust is the accumulated decay of time and memories.
Collected from the fine layers it forms around hotspots in the loop. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

items.name: Ancestral Memories
items.desc:
The echo of a genetic possibility, forgotten by evolution. It twitches with a wild energy.
Extracted from a creature caught within a repeating circuit of time. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

items.name: Atlantideum
items.desc:
This ethereal substance spills from the bodies of corrupted Sentinels as they fall, a shower of prismatic grains seeking out their next host. It evades all attempts to contain it, as if it had a will of its own, a strong desire for its own freedom.
It possesses a crystalline beauty that cannot be reconciled with the corruption from whence it flows.

items.name: Void Mote
items.desc:
A purified drop of Atlantideum, refined to its very essence. This precious material is acquired by earning favour with and assisting the Autophage.
Visit the Autophage Synthesis Terminal found at all Autophage camps to exchange Void Motes for unique customisation options.

items.name: Shattered Qualia
items.desc:
A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into an ethereal shard of glass. This fragment of data represents a trace of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.
Released upon the destruction of a boundary horror.

items.name: Quartzite
items.desc:
A chromatic mineral, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.
Quartzite is found on planets orbiting purple stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.name: Polished Stone
items.desc:
The powdery remains of a highly polished mineral surface. It glitters as it catches the light, like fiery grains of sand.
Acquired by applying the Mining Laser to the structral remnants located on ruined worlds.

items.name: Lithium
items.desc:
Local metallic extract, typically found in large deposits or harvested from common mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Typically found on ocean planets.

items.name: Crystallised Helium
items.desc:
A supercooled chemical extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from smaller mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
Extracted from deposits formed in the hostile conditions of gas giants.

items.name: Methane
items.desc:
An atmospheric gas found in the hostile conditions of gas giants.
Methane is readily harvested from equipment deployed on gas worlds.

items.name: Activated Quartzite
items.desc:
A chromatic mineral, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.
Quartzite is found on planets orbiting purple stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.
This quartzite has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

items.name: Antimatter
items.desc:
Contained negative matter and baryogenesis antiparticles.
The vast energy potential of antimatter makes it highly valuable. 95% of existing antimatter consumption is in the powering of starship hyperdrives.
WARNING: uncontained usage is not recommended.

items.name: Antimatter Housing
items.desc:
Secure antimatter containment device, required before Antimatter can be safely secured as Warp Cells.
Rebound Oxygen forms a protective gas pocket, preventing the antimatter from reacting with the surrounding casing.

items.name: Carbon Nanotubes
items.desc:
Metres and metres of high capacity carbon nanotubes.
Their high tensile strength and mild conductivity make these a key component in many advanced technologies.

items.name: Cobalt Mirror
items.desc:
A specialist optical component.
Employing a polished cobalt surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.

items.name: Hermetic Seal
items.desc:
A high-performance carbon seal, able to withstand both the harsh interstellar environment and the rigours of intensive, high-energy industrial use.
User is advised to regularly check seal integrity after installation.

items.name: Metal Plating
items.desc:
A lightweight metal product, heavily used in the manufacture of starship parts and deployable technology. A mainstay of the construction industries of all known primary species.
Crafted from Ferrite Dust.

items.name: Microprocessor
items.desc:
A compact, low-heat microchip. Assembled from processed Chromatic Metal, created from one of several specialised terrain metals.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.name: Oxygen Filter
items.desc:
A specialist technology component.
This small device can rapidly change the gaseous environment within a device, handling conditions from total vacuum to pure oxygen atmospheres.

items.name: Salt Refractor
items.desc:
A specialist technology component, vital to the complex internals of modern laser systems.
This light-scattering device takes advantage of the unique optical properties of stabilised and polished salt, to both slow and refract passing photons.

items.name: Sodium Diode
items.desc:
An advanced circuit component.
The refined sodium electrode within its vacuum tube gives this diode specialist surge-protection capabilities.

items.name: Di-hydrogen Jelly
items.desc:
A faintly-glowing jelly. Its gentle light and soft wobble belie the fact that this sticky gel is both highly toxic and highly flammable. Skin contact is to be avoided at all costs.
Synthesised from Di-hydrogen.

items.name: Fuel Oxidiser
items.desc:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.
This powerful fuel upgrade overloads frigate engines, allowing for faster-than-usual travel.

items.name: Explosive Drones
items.desc:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.
This pack of autonomous explosives have been programmed to launch from the fleet and pilot themselves directly towards hostile vessels. Extremely dangerous.

items.name: Holographic Analyser
items.desc:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.
This powerful analytic computer overclocks the existing fleet systems, allowing for faster-than-light calculations. Heat is a problem, and the chips do not last long.

items.name: Mind Control Device
items.desc:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.
The mind control device plugs into the ship's trading and communications systems, allowing the Fleet Commander to gain the upper hand in any negotiation.

items.name: Mineral Compressor
items.desc:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.
The mineral compressor allows fleet mining crews to liquidise the substances they extract, for both faster processing and easier transportation.

items.name: Warp Cell
items.desc:
This antimatter-based fuel is one of the few power sources capable of meeting the incredible energy requirements of a starship hyperdrive.
Secured within a robust housing, the cell is guaranteed paradox-free during FTL travel.

items.name: Warp Hypercore
items.desc:
A high-capacity antimatter-based fuel, this cell harnesses an internal black hole generator to power starship hyperdrives across multiple warp jumps.
Cell walls are specially designed to reflect any reality paradoxes back towards the heart of the unit, where they generate additional power.

items.name: Unstable Plasma
items.desc:
Densely-packed fuel capsule for use in the Plasma Launcher.
Contained highly-pressurised electro-thermal energy for use in land disruption grenade technology.

items.name: Ion Battery
items.desc:
Convenient and optimised power storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems.
Constructed by fusing Ferrite Dust with underground Cobalt. Frequently found ready-made in cylindrical metal containers.

items.name: Advanced Ion Battery
items.desc:
Powerful energy storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems.
Constructed from Ionised Cobalt and Pure Ferrite, and occasionally found in cylindrical metal containers.

items.name: Starshield Battery
items.desc:
A power storage unit optimised for use in starship defensive systems.
Tritium-fuelled capacitors provide quick-release charge for the Deflector Shield, but would overload smaller-scale equipment.

items.name: Life Support Gel
items.desc:
Emergency life support fuel.
Synthesised from rocket fuel crystals and carbon, this gel offers a temporary boost to life support systems. Long-term impact on user's lungs is currently unknown.

items.name: Oxygen Capsule
items.desc:
Stablised and secure life support filtration gas.
Easily assembled from Oxygen and Ferrite Dust. Offers an efficient method for long-term life support power.

items.name: Frigate Fuel (50 Tonnes)
items.desc:
A small barrel of frigate fuel.
This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

items.name: Frigate Fuel (100 Tonnes)
items.desc:
A large barrel of frigate fuel.
This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

items.name: Frigate Fuel (200 Tonnes)
items.desc:
A huge barrel of frigate fuel.
This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

items.name: Starship Launch Fuel
items.desc:
Highly reactive solid-state fuel, required to fuel Starship Launch Thrusters.
Created from crystallised Di-hydrogen, found in blue deposits on all worlds.

items.name: Hydrothermal Fuel Cell
items.desc:
A high thermal energy fuel, contained within a standardised fuel cell. Used to fuel the Humboldt Drive that powers the Nautilon submarine.
Created with a mix of organic compounds (Carbon and cyto-phosphates) and localised mineral salts.

items.name: Projectile Ammunition
items.desc:
Advanced munition fragments, constructed to fit Universal Multi-Tool Standard 07/FF1.
Easily inserted into the Boltcaster, Pulse Spitter and Scatter Blaster via the Multi-Tool clip reloading system.

items.name: Carbon Crystal
items.desc:
Hyper-compressed carbon, this substance's dense nanostructure makes it highly valuable as both an energy source and a technology component.
Synthesised from Condensed Carbon.

items.name: Chloride Lattice
items.desc:
A tightly-bonded form of Chlorine. Rigidly-packed molecules offer unrivalled conductivity. Not known to form spontaneously: creation requires highly-focused energy inputs.
Synthesised from Chlorine.

items.name: Destablised Sodium
items.desc:
Sodium is typically highly stable, but certain configurations retain the reactivity of its component ions. User is advised to wear Hazardous Material Gauntlets before handling.
Synthesised from Sodium.

items.name: Rare Metal Element
items.desc:
A highly-prized metal product, this rare element is used in the manufacture of several advanced technologies.
Metal is highly reactive and quickly bonds to exposed skin. User is advised to handle with extreme caution.
Synthesised from Magnetised Ferrite.

items.name: Superoxide Crystal
items.desc:
A para-magnetic form of Oxygen, this rare substance has much to offer in the production of advanced technologies. Requires conversion prior to input into Life Support systems. Direct inhalation is NOT recommended.
Synthesised from Oxygen.

items.name: TetraCobalt
items.desc:
A novel molecular form of Cobalt, requiring very high energy levels to create. Natural occurrence is extremely rare.
Synthesised from Ionised Cobalt.

items.name: Acid
items.desc:
Dilute acid for high current generation in diverse power cells.
Crafted from Mordite and Fungal Mould.

items.name: Heat Capacitor
items.desc:
A thermal regulator produced from refined organic material. It is unique in its ability to produce, dissipate and distribute heat as required.
Crafted from Solanium and Frost Crystals.

items.name: Poly Fibre
items.desc:
A connective fibre for electronics, made from an advanced synthetic polymer and capable of serving as a conduit for power and data.
Crafted from Cactus Flesh and Star Bulbs.

items.name: Circuit Board
items.desc:
Stackable, semi-flexible circuit board made from a highly durable synthetic polymer.
Crafted from Heat Capacitors and Poly Fibre.

items.name: Glass
items.desc:
Shatter-proof, scratch-resistant glass with a self-cleaning, UV-cured coating, for general construction use.
Refined from Silicate powder. Extract silicate from the earth with a Terrain Manipulator.
Can be crafted from Frost Crystals extracted from plants on frozen worlds.

items.name: Unstable Gel
items.desc:
A highly reactive gel, this substance is both energy-rich and dangerous to touch.
Crafted from Cactus Flesh.

items.name: Liquid Explosive
items.desc:
A general purpose high explosive, offered in liquid form for convenience of transport and deployment. Do not drink.
Crafted from Acid and Unstable Gel.

items.name: Lubricant
items.desc:
A synthetic lubricant that reduces wear and prolongs the lifespan of technologies with moving parts.
Crafted from Faecium and Gamma Root.

items.name: Living Glass
items.desc:
An advanced building material, this glass has been imbued with organic compounds that allow it to react to the environment. Microbes within the glass filter harmful light of all wavelengths and balance the atmosphere as required.
Crafted from Lubricant and Glass.

items.name: Enriched Carbon
items.desc:
A refined product, taking ordinary carbon and boosting it with radioactive energy.
Crafted from Radon and Condensed Carbon.

items.name: Nitrogen Salt
items.desc:
A refined product, this is a powerful organic fertiliser in an easily distributed form.
Crafted from Nitrogen and Condensed Carbon.

items.name: Thermic Condensate
items.desc:
A refined product, holding the energy potential of heated atmospheric gas in a stable state until required.
Crafted from Sulphurine and Condensed Carbon.

items.name: Hot Ice
items.desc:
A paradoxical material, made less mysterious by its relative ease of manufacture.
Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Nitrogen Salt.

items.name: Cryo-Pump
items.desc:
An advanced, self-regulating hybrid material, the Cryo-Pump distributes heat across itself with near perfect efficiency, making it vital in the creation of thermal regulators.
Crafted from Hot Ice and Thermic Condensate

items.name: Semiconductor
items.desc:
An advanced material useful in many electronic devices, with its own in-built temperature regulator.
Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Nitrogen Salt.

items.name: Organic Catalyst
items.desc:
A catalytic material used in the creation of many organic fertilisers.
Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Enriched Carbon.

items.name: Superconductor
items.desc:
An advanced conductive material, the superconductor further enriches the field-warping power of the Semiconductor.
Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Semiconductors.

items.name: Fusion Accelerant
items.desc:
An advanced fuel source, made from a perfect blend of high potential energy organic materials.
Crafted from Organic Catalyst and Nitrogen Salt.

items.name: Cryogenic Chamber
items.desc:
A low temperature chamber, designed to prevent the natural decay of organic matter.
Crafted from Living Glass and a Cryo-Pump.

items.name: Portable Reactor
items.desc:
A miniature self-controlled nuclear reactor. Generates sub-stellar levels of energy in a hassle-free, widely compatible fuel module.
Crafted from Liquid Explosives and Fusion Accelerant.

items.name: Quantum Processor
items.desc:
A highly advanced computational device, essential for the complex calculations involved in warp travel.
Crafted from Circuit Boards and Superconductors.

items.name: Aronium
items.desc:
A lightweight and highly malleable alloy. Crafted from Paraffinium and Ionised Cobalt.
In high demand on the Galactic Trade Network due to its utility in the construction of planetside outposts and facilities.

items.name: Dirty Bronze
items.desc:
A popular metal alloy with a wide variety of uses. 'Dirty Bronze' has shed its scientific name in favour of the popular term for its colour.
Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Pyrite.

items.name: Grantine
items.desc:
Soft workable alloy favoured by artisans throughout the known galaxy. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Dioxite.
A popular trading good, with many galactic shipping paths devoted to its sale and transport.

items.name: Herox
items.desc:
Combined neutral alloy with uses that range from pharmacology all the way to heavy industry. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Ammonia.
Forms the backbone of galactic alloy trading.

items.name: Magno-Gold
items.desc:
Highly prized and lustrous alloy. Popular with traders of all known primary galactic races. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Phosphorus.
Easily recognisable by its bright red glow and strong magnetic field.

items.name: Lemmium
items.desc:
Pure Ferrite alloy. Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Uranium.
Used extensively in starship freighter construction due to its sheer strength. A hardcore material popular on the Galactic Trade Network.

items.name: Geodesite
items.desc:
Advanced and durable alloy primarily used in starship hull construction and deep-space exploration drone technology.
Crafted from Herox, Dirty Bronze and Lemmium.

items.name: Iridesite
items.desc:
Advanced light metal alloy traded throughout the galactic Outer Edge. Often used in the interiors of trading shuttles to reduce weight as they ascend from planets with high gravitational fields.
Crafted from Aronium, Magno-Gold and Grantine.

items.name: Fusion Ignitor
items.desc:
A highly advanced piece of technology for use in the next generation of power plants. Producing a fusion core requires both intricate scientific skills and complex industrial processes.
Crafted from Portable Reactor, Quantum Processors and Geodesite.

items.name: Stasis Device
items.desc:
A device specifically crafted to keep lifeforms alive for thousands of years longer than their natural lifespan. Such a device requires great skill to manufacture, as not only is it technically complex, but the consequences for a user in the event of malfunction would be disastrous.
Crafted from Quantum Processors, Cryogenic Chambers, and Iridesite.

items.name: Wiring Loom
items.desc:
A prefabricated circuit board, designed for flexible use in a large range of technology components.
The module features an integrated nanite processor, allowing it to be quickly configured for a wide variety of uses.

items.name: Fragile Neural Stem
items.desc:
A delicate web of living tissue, this is the spark that will ignite a new lifeform into existence.
It requires careful attendance while it matures.

items.name: Fragile Heart
items.desc:
Though nothing more than a cluster of cells, it is already possible to detect the soft beating of this proto-heart.
It requires careful attendance while it matures.

items.name: Fragile Shell
items.desc:
Translucent and impossibly thin, this shell is no more than the merest breath of glass. And yet the potential is clear, a relentless multiplicative hardening adding constantly to its strength.
It requires careful attendance while it matures.

items.name: Growing Singularity
items.desc:
A slow knitting together of flesh, neurons and antimatter. The way this mind experiences the universe is beyond any imagining.
It requires careful attendance while it matures.

items.name: Mature Neural Stem
items.desc:
This web of living tissue has grown its own metallic filaments, a mesh of silver and flesh. It crackles with its own electric charge, a network in need of its nodes.
It awaits its host.

items.name: Mature Heart Node
items.desc:
Powerful and muscular, this bionic pump sits within a network of synthetic tubes. It twitches when touched, its rhythms sensitive to the presence of other thinking entities.
It awaits its host.

items.name: Hardened Shell
items.desc:
Translucent, reflective, iridescent, impossibly strong. This shell swiftly reconfigures itself upon damage, knitting itself back together stronger than ever before. The newly formed bonds create a memory in glass, reflecting back the light absorbed at the moment of damage.
It awaits its host.

items.name: Singularity Core
items.desc:
A sensitive arrangement of neurons in a stable orbit around a miniature black hole. The mind at the heart of this bionic miracle is free from the constraints of linear time, its experience an impossible web of myriad collected lifeforms.
It awaits its host.

items.name: Consciousness Bridge
items.desc:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
This device appears to offer an interface between an individual entity and a greater shared consciousness. It appears derived from, but not attuned to, Korvax technology.

items.name: Pulsating Core
items.desc:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
Organic, but aglow with heat and possessing a highly-pressurised inner vessel. This 'device' is part pump, and part accelerated evolutionary chamber.

items.name: Impossible Membrane
items.desc:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
A fine mesh of tightly woven fibre. Micro-organisms embedded within the weave allow it to regenerate endlessly, a perfect and infinite bionic skin.

items.name: Seeds of Glass
items.desc:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
Capsules of genetic material, encased in a film of living glass. Shared memories swim in the their reflective surfaces, waiting for their chance to shape the life within.

items.name: Archived Soul
items.desc:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
A fusion of complex circuitry and the ineffable glitch of the Traveller. Such a calculus might bind realities together, or tear them into mere simulated fragments.

items.name: Soul Chamber (0%)
items.desc:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
A fusion of complex circuitry and the ineffable glitch of the Traveller. Such a calculus might bind realities together, or tear them into mere simulated fragments.

items.name: Living Water
items.desc:
Unusual surface interactions cause this liquid to quickly split into small, perfect, spheres. Light refracted through one such sphere splits into colours beyond description.
Of unknown origin.

items.name: Repair Kit
items.desc:
A highly useful piece of survival technology, the Repair Kit allows damaged equipment to be quickly and efficiently restored to working order.
While repairing a piece of techology, the Repair Kit can be applied to any damaged subcomponent in place of the usual requirements.

items.name: Once-Useful Springs
items.desc:
A valuable piece of broken down starship, created by a Starship Outfitting Terminal at a Space Station.
Component is useful only as scrap to be sold at a Trade Terminal.

items.name: Handful of Cogs
items.desc:
A valuable piece of broken down starship, created by a Starship Outfitting Terminal at a Space Station.
Component is useful only as scrap to be sold at a Trade Terminal.

items.name: Reinforced Piping
items.desc:
A valuable piece of broken down starship, created by a Starship Outfitting Terminal at a Space Station.
Component is useful only as scrap to be sold at a Trade Terminal.

items.name: Hydraulic Wiring
items.desc:
Specialist wiring and control threads, this flexible material allows the transmission of power and signals, as well as offering direct manipulation of remote components.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.name: Quantum Computer
items.desc:
An extremely fast advanced processing unit. Allows real-time solving of otherwise impossible calculations. However, protection against decoherence is not guaranteed.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.name: Magnetic Resonator
items.desc:
An electromagnetic frequency oscillator, able to function in a wide-range of conditions thanks to both ferrous and non-ferrous magnetic properties.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.name: Solar Mirror
items.desc:
A specialist optical component. Employing an impossibly polished surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.name: Amino Chamber
items.desc:
A specialist biological catalysation device.
This unit takes advantage of naturally occurring enzymes in order to facilitate increased energy yields and faster processing in a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.name: Geode
items.desc:
An unusually vibrant and potentially valuable lump of rock.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Sentinel Boundary Map
items.desc:
A strange, shifting map. Though hard to focus upon, this chart appears to show the location of a nearby Sentinel Pillar. Such Sentinel strongholds house many secrets...
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

items.name: Undamaged Drone Shell
items.desc:
The shell of a Sentinel drone, all that remains after its destruction in combat. While the exterior is physically intact, its internals have been severely burned.
Given the right tools and several exotic components, it may be possible to repair it.

items.name: Nanite Filament
items.desc:
A thin, shimmering thread, once owned by Iteration: Gemini. This impossible fibre, once a treasured keepsake, sings on the wavelength of the Space Anomaly.
A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

items.name: Portal Phylactery
items.desc:
A vial of the portal's blue amber, given to you by Iteration: Mercury. The ether of the Atlas itself, this is primeval liquid from which it weaves the multiverse.
A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

items.name: Beads of Glass
items.desc:
A handful of glassy orbs, once owned by Specialist Polo. Their pearlescent surface does not reflect the world around them, offering instead a mirror to different reality.
A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

items.name: Pristine Brain
items.desc:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.
Unlike most Walker brains, this one has survived its violent extraction and is pristine and undamaged. It could potentially be installed in a new vessel...

items.name: Hacked Brain
items.desc:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile.
Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by Iteration: Tethys. Its new-found freedom from the Atlas has been noted by the universe.

items.name: Deep-Space Lure
items.desc:
A single-use device for locating a deep-space Gaseous Sentience. The lure generates an electromagnetic field of an intriguing nature to these highly advanced lifeforms.
Select the Lure and use Generate Field (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

items.name: Neutron Cannon Module
items.desc:
A moderate upgrade for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

items.name: Neutron Cannon Module
items.desc:
A significant upgrade for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

items.name: Neutron Cannon Module
items.desc:
An extremely powerful upgrade for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

items.name: Neutron Cannon Module
items.desc:
A supremely powerful upgrade for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

items.name: Suspicious Neutron Cannon Module
items.desc:
A black-market modification for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

items.name: Sentinel Weapons Shard
items.desc:
An anomalous upgrade for the Multi-Tool's Weapon Systems. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
This eerie, glassy shard has been extracted from Sentinel debris. Its exact effect upon the Multi-Tool will not be known until after installation is complete.

items.name: Sentinel Exosuit Fragment
items.desc:
An anomalous upgrade for Exosuit. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
This strange fragment of debris has been extracted from Sentinel technology. Its exact effect upon suit performance is impossible to predict before the nantite foam has fully spread within the Exosuit's systems.

items.name: Temporal Starship Trail
items.desc:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.
A cosmic resonance chamber interacts with starship exhaust, modifying propulsion energy to leave a streak of temporal disturbances.
Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

items.name: Pre-Packaged %NAME% Unit
items.desc:
A pre-built wiring package, designed to allow easy installation of core technology. Use FE_ALT1 to begin the installation process.
%TECH_DESC%

items.name: Gamma Weed
items.desc:
A luminous, leafy flowering plant that thrives in radioactive biomes and can be cultivated to yield a bountiful harvest.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Radioactive climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 4 hours

items.name: Fungal Cluster
items.desc:
A spherical fungus with internal gills, found only in toxic biomes. Fungal Clusters can be transplanted for cultivation, yielding a bountiful harvest.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Toxic climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 4 hours

items.name: Frostwort
items.desc:
A large crystal flower with radiant blue blooms, found only in snowy biomes. Frostwort can be farmed and makes a reliable crop, and its adaptation to harsh conditions results in highly frequent harvests.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Frozen climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 1 hour

items.name: Venom Urchin
items.desc:
A small, innocuous looking plant whose leaves periodically secrete a small amount of potent Sac Venom, a valuable trading commodity.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 3 hours 20 mins

items.name: Solar Vine
items.desc:
This 'living rock' is adapted to live in the extreme heat of scorched biomes. However, it can be farmed in most environments and, once established, yields a moderate harvest.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Hot climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 16 hours

items.name: Gutrot Flower
items.desc:
A foul-smelling, farmable flower that replicates the chemical structure of faecal matter. When planted inside, yields a harvest of Faecium.
A good alternative to collecting Faecium by hand, which requires feeding creatures and then harvesting their droppings. Gutrot Flowers must be grown in a Hydroponics Tray.
Approximate growing time: 4 hours

items.name: Gravitino Host
items.desc:
A strange, potentially parasitic plant that yields an occasional harvest of the highly tradable commodity, Gravitino Balls.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 2 hours

items.name: Mordite Root
items.desc:
An inedible tuber that produces a small yield of Mordite crystals.
A peaceful alternative to the process of harvesting Mordite from the corpses of creatures. Mordite Root must be grown in a Hydroponics Tray.
Approximate growing time: 8 hours

items.name: Echinocactus
items.desc:
Native to barren biomes and capable of withstanding long periods of drought, Echinocactus is an edible succulent that responds well to cultivation, yielding a large but occasional harvest.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Barren climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 16 hours

items.name: Star Bramble
items.desc:
A medium-sized, farmable plant that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Star Bulbs.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Lush climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 4 hours

items.name: Albumen Pearl Orb
items.desc:
A medium-sized, farmable Crystal Orb that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Albumen Pearls.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 80 mins

items.name: NipNip
items.desc:
This medicinal herb is known for its pungent buds, which are harvested to produce Gek Nip. NipNip thrives in dank environments, and often grows as a weed.
Suitable for hydroponic planting indoors. Needs a tropical or humid climate before planting outdoors.

items.name: C-Class Reactor
items.desc:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The basic generator unit is capable of powering a C-Class starship.
Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

items.name: B-Class Reactor
items.desc:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The upgraded generator unit is capable of powering a B-Class starship.
Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

items.name: A-Class Reactor
items.desc:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The advanced generator unit is capable of powering an A-Class starship.
Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

items.name: S-Class Reactor
items.desc:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The exceptional generator unit is capable of powering an S-Class starship.
Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

items.name: Quad Servo
items.desc: A highly sprung motor arm salvaged from inside of a Sentinel patrol unit. It occasionally twitches, as if experiencing the echo of combat.

items.name: Walker Brain
items.desc:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch.
A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.

items.name: Mind Ark
items.desc: A strange piece of technology, a gift from beyond the stars. It shimmers in a way that suggests it is not fully in this world.

items.name: Captured Nanode
items.desc: Atlas Seed containing zonally-shifted quasi-stellar substrate. Warning: do not allow matrix to commune with this dimensional space.

items.name: Englobed Shade
items.desc: This Atlas Shell holds the remains of a parasitic space-borne lifeform, most likely of extra-dimensional origins.

items.name: Noospheric Orb
items.desc: An Atlas Seed capable of resonating on humanoid telepathic frequencies; may attempt to subsume any subordinate intellect in close proximity.

items.name: Dark Matter
items.desc: An Atlas Seed shell encompassing a void element harvested from the collapse state of the last universe. Toxic if ingested.

items.name: Dawn's End
items.desc: Sculpted tau neutrino-boson matrix fixed within an irreplaceable Atlas Seed shell. May be semi-sentient.

items.name: Photic Jade
items.desc: This irreplaceable Atlas Seed is a form of matter-adapted photons coalesced into physical solidity by unknown means.

items.name: State Phasure
items.desc: For unknown reasons, this unique Atlas Seed has been phased out of alignment with this quantum reality. Contents cannot be determined.

items.name: Novae Reclaiment
items.desc: Atlas Seed contains neutronium elements from a catastrophic supernova event that obliterated a sentient civilization in an earlier era.

items.name: Modified Quanta
items.desc: This one-of-a-kind Atlas Seed holds an aesthetically pleasing mathematical construct salvaged from the simulation of an alternate reality.

items.name: Heart of the Sun
items.desc: An Atlas Seed containing a time-locked quantum cilia suspended in a photonic shell. No others are known to exist.

items.name: NipNip Buds
items.desc: A pungent bud harvested from the NipNip plant, often used to produce Gek Nip.

items.name: Larval Core
items.desc: A pulsating jellied orb, this gooey sphere is warm to the touch. Its stench triggers a primal fear in mortal beings, a deep-seated gnawing that begs you to drop it and flee.

items.name: Living Pearl
items.desc:
Born in the hearts of enormous glowing molluscs found deep underwater.
Unlike most pearls, this sample is no unliving calcite. Some trace of the mother-clam's consciousness remains within the gem, giving it a lingering, haunting beauty.

items.name: Hypnotic Eye
items.desc:
The eye is cold, almost frozen, to the touch. Nonetheless, it is impossible to escape the feeling it is somehow still alive.
Extended exposure is not recommended. Do not stare back into the eye. Do not stare back. Do not stare back.

items.name: Hadal Core
items.desc:
A highly-pressurised fleshy orb.
One can feel it push back when touched, a flash of bioluminescence stirring in the inky black core of this mysterious object.

items.name: Soul Engine
items.desc:
A powerful organic computing unit.
A glitching beat drives this miracle circuit, performing cycle after cycle in an endless, furious loop of calculation.

items.name: Storm Crystal
items.desc: A rare and highly valuable cluster of storm crystals. These crystalline structures thrive in stormy conditions, and naturally attract lightning strikes, becoming spectacularly luminescent when ionised. Exclusively found on extreme weather planets.

items.name: Albumen Pearl
items.desc:
Gemstone formed over the course of centuries within the egg of a super-incubatory species. Highly ornamental, these gems are themselves living seeds, lucent grains of potential life.
Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

items.name: Gravitino Ball
items.desc:
A supersymmetric particle cluster created by divergent super-gravitational forces. A micro-rift is created as they form, and extraction of the orb prompts a localised reality weakening. Sentinel forces will respond to stablise any such anomaly.
Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

items.name: Sac Venom
items.desc:
A stabilised poison gland extracted from a terrestrial urchin. The host-urchin is actually a colony of smaller proto-creatures, a formation built on years of slow growth and cooperation.
Of use both medicinally and as a delicacy in some riskier cuisines.
Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

items.name: Vortex Cube
items.desc:
An ancient object, unearthed from the depths of a planetary cave system. Its surface is cold to the touch, and is curiously polished despite its age.
A fusion of metal and rock, these cubes have proved resistant to industrial processing. As such, they are of value only to collectors.
Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

items.name: Atlas Stone
items.desc:
A spherical gem that seems to pulsate with red light from its centre.
An extremely rare item often associated with ancient monolithic sites.

items.name: Hex Core
items.desc: This strange energy orb constantly vibrates, emitting a low-frequency drone. Slight variations in the pattern repeat over and over, almost as if it is attempting to relay a message.

items.name: Geode
items.desc:
An unusually vibrant and potentially valuable lump of rock.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Crystal Fragment
items.desc:
A crystalline shard with an unusually dense structure. Potentially highly valuable.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Tritium Hypercluster
items.desc:
A shard of pure crystalised Tritium.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Gold Nugget
items.desc:
A highly valuable ore chunk, ready to be processed into Gold.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Crystal Sulphide
items.desc:
Formed in the incredible, high-pressure furnace of planetary cores, these rich mineral deposits have an almost glass-like quality.
Has a wide variety of industrial uses, taking advantage of both its mineral content and its extreme strength under pressure.

items.name: Vy'keen Tablet
items.desc:
A stone tablet bearing line after line of intricate runes. The words are unintelligible, an ancient dialect forgotten by all but the oldest of the Vy'keen elders.
The hand that carved this stone must have been extraordinary. The stonework is precise, delicate - and yet perfectly conveys the unyielding aggression its writer clearly possessed.

items.name: Divergence Cube
items.desc:
A glitching, pulsing data unit. It does not seem to belong in this reality.
The cube gives the impression of a silent scream, the frozen cries of hundreds of lost minds trapped within.

items.name: Gek Relic
items.desc:
A metal statuette of a creature with a coin placed in its beak.
Popular with many traders who see it as an emblem of fair commerce and peace.

items.name: GekNip
items.desc:
Edible product much beloved by the Gek.
Allows beaked traders to release delightfully scented packets of gas for a prolonged period of time.
GekNip gas packets are considered an art form, and the truest representation of the Gek soul.

items.name: Vy'keen Effigy
items.desc:
A small wooden icon carved into the shape of a Sentinel drone.
Used by warriors to enter a temporary trance-like state that eliminates their kind's need for sleep.

items.name: Vy'keen Dagger
items.desc: Largely ceremonial weapon. A vital part of Vy'keen tradition and culture.

items.name: Korvax Casing
items.desc:
The metallic shell of a disconnected electronic lifeform that was too distant from its kind to be refreshed with a new entity.
Highly prized by all species, not least its own.

items.name: Convergence Cube
items.desc: Device used by the Korvax for the storage of historical and cultural information.

items.name: Void Egg
items.desc:
An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched.
A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.

items.name: Active Void Egg
items.desc:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.
When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a world beset by powerful anomalies and strange colours.

items.name: Stirring Void Egg
items.desc:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.
When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a dust-covered world of extreme storms.

items.name: Awakened Void Egg
items.desc:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.
When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a water world covered in lush and verdant plantlife.

items.name: Cracking Void Egg
items.desc:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.
When touched, conjures a powerful visions of a planet of strange anomalies, one minute a world of grass, the next a world of bizarre fungal growths...

items.name: Anomaly Detector
items.desc:
A single-use geometric beacon that probes the surrounding area for near-space anomalies. Such objects are highly unpredictable.
Select the Detector and use Begin Scan (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

items.name: Emergency Signal Scanner
items.desc:
A single-use receiver that scans for distress signals on freighter frequencies. Derelict or abandoned freighters often contain high-value salvage.
Select the Receiver and use Tune Signal (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

items.name: Emergency Signal Scanner (Active)
items.desc:
A single-use receiver that scans for distress signals on freighter frequencies. Derelict or abandoned freighters often contain high-value salvage.
Select the Receiver and use Tune Signal (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

items.name: Encrypted Navigation Computer
items.desc:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship navigation, flight stabilisation, and external sensors.
This part could be in working order, but will require decryption before it can be installed in a new ship. A paired decryption terminal can be located via Exosuit analysis.

items.name: Encrypted Navigation Computer
items.desc:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship navigation, flight stabilisation, and external sensors.

items.name: Navigation Computer
items.desc:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship navigation, flight stabilisation, and external sensors.
The part appears intact, functional, and ready to be installed in a new ship.

items.name: Encrypted Communicator Control Unit
items.desc:

items.desc:

items.name: Encrypted User Authenticator
items.desc:

items.name: Encrypted User Authenticator

items.name: User Authenticator
items.desc:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship-to-Exosuit synchronisation and security.
The part appears intact, functional, and ready to be installed in a new ship.

items.name: Freighter Recolouring
items.desc:
Unlocks this colour for freighter customisation.
A self-replicating cloud of highly pigmatised nano-robots swarm the capital ship, changing its external appearance.

items.name: Station Override
items.desc:
A portable data drive containing the AI override codes for a Space Station Core.
The importance of the station AI core ensures that such keys are both highly regulated and extremely profitable on the black market.

items.name: Whalestalker Cloak
items.desc:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.
This sweeping cloak was once worn by an ill-fated Traveller - obsessed with their quest to capture a cosmic leviathan, and doomed to repeat the chase for all eternity.
Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

items.name: Organic Frigate
items.desc:
This peaceful space giant is a mutation of organism and starcraft, and can be tamed to swim through the stars alongside a fleet of frigates.
Recruiting this creature will add it to your frigate fleet. Manage your fleet from a Fleet Command Room aboard your freighter, and consult your Navigator to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.

items.name: Title: 'Looper'
items.desc:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Leviathan expedition, and the lifting of a generation-spanning curse.
Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

items.name: Writhing Manuscript
items.desc:
A translucent sheet of worm-vellum, inscribed with a fanatical text. It writhes when touched.
'The children were the first to notice.
A thump thump thump, thundering deep below the sand.
The first worm split the sky like black lightning as it leapt overhead.
Worm by worm, they rose from the desert. Migrating.
Every storm season, we each hope to be chosen. We arrange ourselves in lines across the desert, arms lifted to the sky.
Anyone may enter the maw.
We are all equal under the great worms.'

items.name: Flesh Rope
items.desc:
The coiled remains of a Hungering Tendril's digestive tract. Though its meaty walls still convulse, there is surely no way for a fresh tendril to regrow from these meagre scraps...
Such specialist offal is rarely traded on the Galactic Exchange and is thus highly valuable.

items.name: Vile Spawn
items.desc:
The fragile embryo of a Hungering Tendril, still dripping with mucal butter. It wails and recoils when touched.
May be extracted from embryotic sacs with the aid of a Visceral Synthesiser.

items.name: Forged Passport
items.desc:
A counterfeit starship registration document. This digital signature is guaranteed free of previous crimes or misdemeanors.
Can be used to reset any negative faction standing records at a Space Station Core.

items.name: Pirate Map
items.desc: Reassembled treasure coordinate data, retrieved from the victims of pirate faction The Blight.

items.name: Dream Aerial
items.desc:
A signal receiver and amplifier, tuned to the wavelength of the unconscious mind. It is every colour all at once, splitting the surrounding light into a shimmering rainbow.
Warning: Carrying this antenna into deep space may attract the attention of cosmic megafauna.

items.name: Homeworld Repeater
items.desc:
A makeshift device, cobbled from salvaged electronic components kept in deep storage for many years. This jumble of wires will attempt to make contact with the last-known remnants of the freighter's homeworld.
Select the device and select Broadcast (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

items.name: Glowing Mineral
items.desc:
Though its surface is dirtied and dull, polishing this rock reveals a deep inner glow, a glitter beneath a subtly iridescent surface.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Salvaged Glass
items.desc:
A sinister shard of purple glass, salvaged from the destroyed remains of Sentinel machinery. Its walls are thin, and it may be broken down to access valuable Sentinel components.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and shatter with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Hardframe Engine
items.desc:
This complex mechanical unit was once the central combustion chamber at the heart of a Sentinel Hardframe unit.
Though now cool to the touch, it still glows with a sinister red heat...

items.name: Sentinel Flare (Off)
items.desc:
A specialist device, created by Iteration Tethys. Its primary function is to hail your reconstructed Sentinel drone.
Select the device and use Activate Flare (FE_ALT1) to signal [The Drone].
While this flare is active in your Exosuit inventory, the drone will stay by your side while planetside.

items.name: Radiant Brain
items.desc:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile.
Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by both Iteration: Tethys and a Messenger of the Atlas.

items.name: Planetary Chart
items.desc:
A map of a nearby planet. An inhabited outpost of some kind has been marked.
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.
New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

items.name: Ancient Key
items.desc: A key of some weight, this aged piece of wrought iron must belong in a nearby lock...

items.name: Trident Key
items.desc:
A strange forked key, glowing with an ultraviolet light.
Despite its primitive appearance, Exosuit scanning systems reveal traces of nanite foam upon its teeth.

items.name: Sentinel Flare
items.desc:
A specialist device, created by Iteration Tethys. Its primary function is to hail your reconstructed Sentinel drone.
Select the device and use Deactivate Broadcast (FE_ALT1) to stop signalling [ The Sentry ].
While this flare is active in your Exosuit inventory, the drone will stay by your side while planetside.

items.name: Utopia Supply Drop Beta
items.desc:
To support the workers bravely terraforming the lava-filled wastes of planet Pehaelump, the Utopia Overseers are glad to supply this cache of vital goods.
Select the supply pack and use Open Package (FE_ALT1) to collect your Utopia Foundation supplies, as well as details of your next assignment.

items.name: Utopia Supply Drop Gamma
items.desc:
To support the workers valiantly toiling on the steep, exposed mountains of planet New Sesto, the Utopia Overseers are glad to supply this cache of vital goods.
Select the supply pack and use Open Package (FE_ALT1) to collect your Utopia Foundation supplies, as well as details of your next assignment.

items.name: Utopia Supply Drop Delta
items.desc:
To support the surviving workers who now confront the [ REDACTED ] of planet Idalth XIV, the Utopia Overseers are glad to supply this cache of vital goods.
Select the supply pack and use Open Package (FE_ALT1) to collect your Utopia Foundation supplies, as well as details of your next assignment.

items.name: Utopia Supply Drop Epsilon
items.desc:
To support the workers who so nobly rebuild in the sucking quagmires of planet Endil A8, the Utopia Overseers are glad to supply this cache of vital goods.
Select the supply pack and use Open Package (FE_ALT1) to collect your Utopia Foundation supplies, as well as details of your next assignment.

items.name: Settlement Coordinates Beta
items.desc:
A map from the Utopia Foundation, showing personalised coordinates for your target construction site.
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

items.name: Settlement Coordinates Gamma
items.desc:
A map from the Utopia Foundation, showing personalised coordinates for your target construction site.
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

items.name: Settlement Coordinates Delta
items.desc:
A map from the Utopia Foundation, showing personalised coordinates for your target construction site.
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

items.name: Settlement Coordinates Epsilon
items.desc:
A map from the Utopia Foundation, showing personalised coordinates for your target construction site.
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

items.name: Construction History
items.desc:
This report records the history of a planetary facility forming part of the Utopia Project. Several sections are curiously absent.
DS 2368 :: Facility founded. Plasma deep drill rig operational.
DS 2384 :: Return growth steady at 1%.
DS 2400 :: Overseers querying growth rate.
DS 2416 :: Orbital exp. approved. Station trade booming.
DS 2432 :: [Redacted] hazard encountered.
DS 2448 :: [Redacted]
DS 2464 :: Utopia Project launched.
DS 2464 :: Facility restored. Plasma deep drill rig operational. Trade routes re-opened.
DS 2480 :: [Redacted]
DS 2496 :: Facility restored. Plasma deep drill rig ope

items.name: Crystallised Heart
items.desc:
The functional core of a Sentinel quadruped unit, but warped beyond all recognition. The entire machine is infested with a crystalline material that pulses wildy upon inspection.
A close analysis reveals the machinery itself appears to have been reconfigured, stretching and warping into a whole new form, writhing in the presence of these radiant shards of glass.

items.name: Hyaline Brain
items.desc:
The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry writhes microscopically, constantly rearranging itself as it scans for anomalies.
A vital component for any entity wishing to construct their own Pilot Interface for a Sentinel Interceptor.
Status: VOLATILE

items.name: Carrier AI Fragment
items.desc:
A single splinter of the colossal mainframe at the heart of a Sentinel capital ship. It blinks, its solitary living eye trained upon the one piece of data it retains - the last known location of one of its fleet of Interceptors.
Select the AI Fragment and use Search Archive (FE_ALT1) to translate information about Interceptor's crash site to your starship's navigation systems.

items.name: Inverted Mirror
items.desc:
A pane of watchful g l a s s, retrieved from the smoking remains of the corrupted swarm's Dissonance Resonators. It emits more light than it reflects, casting a faint purple hue on its surroundings.
Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key Sentinel ship technologies.

items.name: Radiant Shard
items.desc:
A fragment of glassy lifeforce, chipped from a larger formation. Dynamic intermolecular binding gives the shard a strangely flexible, sinewy quality. It writhes gently, almost as if it were seeking something...
Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key Sentinel ship technologies.

items.name: Echo Locator
items.desc:
A curious mesh of old and new technology, a hybrid between two entirely separate methods of creation. Nonetheless, this location tracing device appears fully functional.
Select this device and use Resonate (FE_ALT1) to trace its harmonic origin.

items.name: Pirate Transponder
items.desc:
A unique ID transponder, ripped from the internal signal array of an outlaw starship.
Possesion of such a device implies the destruction of the vessel in question. Turn it over to an envoy of the Mercenaries Guild to collect any associated bounties.

items.name: Suspicious Packet (Goods)
items.desc:
A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of technology.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and use FE_ALT1 to examine the contents. No refunds.

items.name: Suspicious Packet (Tech)
items.desc:
A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of high-value or interesting item.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and use FE_ALT1 to examine the contents. No refunds.

items.name: Suspicious Packet (Arms)
items.desc:
A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of weapon-based technology.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and use FE_ALT1 to examine the contents. No refunds.

items.name: Mealworms
items.desc:
A piece of specialist bait, designed to improve the size and rarity of your catch.
Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Spicy Chum
items.desc:
A piece of specialist bait, designed to greatly improve the size and rarity of your catch.
Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

items.name: Bionic Lure
items.desc:
A specialist lure, designed to vastly improve the size and rarity of your catch. Of particular interest to anglers seeking legendary fish.

items.name: Dangling Orb
items.desc:

items.name: Shadow Lure

items.name: Magpulse Lure
items.desc:
A specialist lure, designed to attract fish that are only active during storms.
Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

Typically found in shallower water, this is an extremely rare catch.
Will only rise to the surface during the night.

items.name: Abyssal Crab
items.desc:
A medium-sized aquatic creature, found within the deep and murky waters that cloak their oceanic homeworlds.
An unusual specimen, this is a rare catch for most anglers.

items.name: Ocean's Star
items.desc:
A large aquatic creature, found within the deep and murky waters that cloak their oceanic homeworlds.
Typically found in deeper water, this is a rare catch.
Only active during daylight hours.

items.name: Colossal Jawfish
items.desc:
A colossal aquatic creature, found within the deep and murky waters that cloak their oceanic homeworlds.
Typically found in the deepest of water, this is an extremely rare catch.

items.name: Sentient Crab
items.desc:
A small aquatic creature, found within the deep and murky waters that cloak their oceanic homeworlds.
"Deep feeling swims in those watery eyestalks, the thoughtful intelligence of a true ancient."

items.name: Brain Eel
items.desc:
A medium-sized aquatic creature, found within the deep and murky waters that cloak their oceanic homeworlds.
"It slides beneath the waves; it slides between the ears; it slides within the folds, and swims forever in your dreams."

items.name: The Hunter Below
items.desc:
A large aquatic creature, found within the deep and murky waters that cloak their oceanic homeworlds.
"Streamlined, deadly, perfect: the terror of the deep."

items.name: Leviathan Spawn
items.desc:
A colossal aquatic creature, found within the deep and murky waters that cloak their oceanic homeworlds.
"So young and fragile, despite its years beneath the waves. And yet thousands more years must pass before it joins the great herd in the stars..."

items.name: Gas-Worm
items.desc:

Abundant in numbers and typically found in shallower water, this is a relatively common catch.

items.name: Pressurised Clam

items.desc:

Though plentiful in numbers, their cautious nature makes this an uncommon catch.
