items.name: Mandelbrot Worm
items.desc:
A small aquatic creature that has somehow adapted to the pools of unforgiving liquid found deep beneath the clouds of gas giants.
"The geometry of its impossible body folds within itself, a writhing thread of flesh and spacetime."

items.name: Mother-of-Quicksilver
items.desc:
A medium-sized aquatic creature that has somehow adapted to the pools of unforgiving liquid found deep beneath the clouds of gas giants.
"Brilliantly ablaze, its surface a perfect liquid sun..."

items.name: Hyper-cockle
items.desc:
A large aquatic creature that has somehow adapted to the pools of unforgiving liquid found deep beneath the clouds of gas giants.
Only active during daylight hours.
"Both alive and not alive; at once a creature, a mineral, and a moment from another time..."

items.name: The Maw of Titan
items.desc:
A colossal aquatic creature that has somehow adapted to the pools of unforgiving liquid found deep beneath the clouds of gas giants.
"So few things survive in waters such as these... so that which thrives should strike fear into the heart of any thinking being."

items.name: Vigilant Stone
items.desc:
An eye of living stone: waiting, watching. A relic left by a slumbering guardian, keeping sentry over ancient creature burial grounds.
Warning: Disturbing the eye may disturb the slumber of living stone guardians. Ensure re-animated guardians are defeated before storing this relic in the home.

items.name: %NAME% Exhibit
items.desc:
%CRE_DESC%
This curated fossil exhibit can be sold, traded, or re-deployed within any habitable base.

items.name: Autophage Settlement Chart
items.desc:
A map showing the location of a nearby Autophage planetary settlement, acquired from an Autophage Synthesis Terminal.
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

items.name: Nanotube Crate
items.desc:
A packed crate of carbon nanotubes.
These tiny but incredibly strong tubes are required in the construction of tiny but incredibly strong scientific components.

items.name: Self-Repairing Heridium
items.desc:
A hopper of self-repairing Heridium. It looks fresh.
Used in the creation of scientific components. Self-repairing heridium is particularly useful for deployment in remote facilities, where maintenance opportunities may be limited or deadly.

items.name: Optical Solvent
items.desc:
Several bottles of optical solvent.
The liquid in these bottles is used to wash away surplus light that may otherwise cause decay in scientific components.

items.name: 5D Torus
items.desc:
A specially manufactured container of five-dimensional tori.
Highly specific materials are required to construct shapes in extra dimensions. These tori are used to contain the strong fields generated in the manufacture of scientific components.

items.name: Superconducting Fibre
items.desc:
A densely layered package of superconducting fibres.
Powerful, flexible, and water-resistant; the controlled magnetic weave of these fibres is vital in the creation of many scientific components.

items.name: Spark Canister
items.desc:
A crate packed with spark canisters.
Many industrial and mining processes have considerable power demands. A counterpart to the slow release of a battery, spark canisters are able to meet these demands instantaneously.

items.name: Industrial-Grade Battery
items.desc:
A packet of well-isolated industrial batteries.
Heavy-duty batteries are required to power deep level miningoperations. These highly durable sources can last for weeks, even in the extremes of heat and pressure found kilometres underground.

items.name: Ohmic Gel
items.desc:
Several packets of ohmic gel.
Power-hungry mining operations are fraught with danger. Ohmic gel helps keep rapidly moving parts both insulated and lubricated.

items.name: Experimental Power Fluid
items.desc:
Corrosion-resistant barrels of an experimental power fluid.
One barrel of this highly volatile concoction is enough to power a space station for weeks on end. Particularly valued by mining economies.

items.name: Fusion Core
items.desc:
A slightly glowing bundle of fusion cores.
Power source, engine, high-capacity heater. A fusion core is the ultimate in deep-space power generation. Highly valued by mining economies looking to make their asteroid colonies more self-sufficient.

items.name: De-Scented Bottles
items.desc:
A loose collection of recycled pheromone bottles.
Vast quantities of pheromones are produced and distributed every day. This has spawned a lucrative trading opportunity for those willing to deal with the waste products. These glass jars have been thoroughly scrubbed and should pose no threat to the carrier.

items.name: Neutron Microscope
items.desc:
A parcel of neutron microscopes.
Scientific economies produce and consume large numbers of microscopes. However, some have slight defects that render them unsuitable for precision work. These are still a trading opportunity, in that they can be sold to those unable to tell the difference.

items.name: Instability Injector
items.desc:
A jumbled box of instability injectors.
Grand experiments often require a large number of variables to be changed in a very short period of time. An instability injector provides such a service. They can also be used to create chaos in market systems; such unethical behaviour represents an excellent trading opportunity.

items.name: Organic Piping
items.desc:
A vat of preserved organic piping. Still warm.
To avoid difficult ethical problems, many labs grow their test subjects on a component level. The leftovers can be profitable in trading economies with relaxed medical regulations.

items.name: Neural Duct
items.desc:
A box of fresh neural ducts.
Neural ducts are temporary inserts designed for a brief boost of concentration and productivity. Useful everywhere, these are highly valued in trading economies where competition between workers is fierce.

items.name: Dirt
items.desc:
Several tonnes of dirt.
Leftover dirt from mining operations. Residual metals can be extracted by specialists in manufacturing economies with the time and equipment to sift through it.

items.name: Unrefined Pyrite Grease
items.desc:
Large jars full of pyrite grease.
A fat solution with a high mineral content. This grease is highly valued by manufacturing economies, where it's used to keep large machinery oiled and glistening.

items.name: Bromide Salt
items.desc:
A crate of bromide salt.
The result of an extensive distillation and evaporation process, the bromide salt vats feed hungry factories in manufacturing systems.

items.name: Polychromatic Zirconium
items.desc:
A sack full of polychromatic zirconium crystals.
These crystals produce lenses of dazzling colour and near-indestructible hardness. Highly valuable in manufacturing economies.

items.name: Re-latticed Arc Crystal
items.desc:
A neatly wrapped parcel of re-latticed arc crystals.
Extremely rare mineral formations, arc crystals are in high demand in manufacturing economies, where their hardness and conductivity is vital to several industrial processes. They also make alluring (if dangerous) jewellery.

items.name: Decommissioned Circuits
items.desc:
A collection of salvaged circuitry.
Power generation economies go through vast numbers of high-tech components. As such, the demand is present even for highly damaged circuits, to be scavenged for parts or just plugged wholesale into low-quality power cores.

items.name: Welding Soap
items.desc:
Several large bars of welding soap.
Used in power generation systems to heat-clean metal diodes before they're fused into batteries.

items.name: Ion Capacitor
items.desc:
A reinforced crate of ion capacitors.
These supercapacitors have an incredibly high energy density. In great demand in power generation economies.

items.name: Autonomous Positioning Unit
items.desc:
A container of positioning units and associated wiring.
These APS units can be used to turn virtually any technology into a self-navigating system. Highly valuable in power generation economies, where they're used to remove conductive organic hands from the manufacturing process.

items.name: Quantum Accelerator
items.desc:
Several large quantum accelerator units.
Capable of propelling matter at unmeasurable speeds, these units are particularly important in power generation economies, where they're used to compress the energy stored in high-grade batteries.

items.name: Star Silk
items.desc:
Several spools of star silk.
Star silk is woven on enormous solar looms in orbit around trading planets. Cosmic ray impact triggers the pattern of the weave, which can then be used in advanced material processing.

items.name: Decrypted User Data
items.desc:
A crate packed with hard drives, each of which contain vast amounts of decrypted user data.
Individually of low value, taken together these repositories can be processed and scanned for valuable data. This processing occurs in systems with advanced material economies.

items.name: Comet Droplets
items.desc:
Several canisters of comet droplets.
An elaborate trading name for chunks of meteorite, these rocks are nonetheless extremely valuable to the advanced material economies that can process them.

items.name: Ion Sphere
items.desc:
A packed crate of ion spheres.
These delicate glass spheres house a small-scale replica of the upper atmosphere. Sparkly and hypnotic to look at, these baubles are also of importance in the manufacture of advanced material alloys.

items.name: Teleport Coordinators
items.desc:
A bundle of precisely calibrated teleport coordinators.
These pin-prick sized circuits are vital to the delicate process of inserting reinforcing material into advanced alloys. They can also aid long-distance sales efforts.

items.name: Enormous Metal Cog
items.desc:
Several huge cogs.
Sturdy, well-made metal gears. While not advanced technology themselves, they're a vital component in countless pieces of high-tech machinery all over the galaxy.

items.name: Non-Stick Piston
items.desc:
Wrapped and greased pistons, ready for shipping.
High-tech components frequently require rapidly moving parts, or high-endurance motors. Without specially coated pistons, the failure rate of such parts would be significantly higher.

items.name: Mesh Decouplers
items.desc:
A crate of mesh decouplers.
The creation of high-tech components often involves accidental mesh-coupling. These decouplers are particularly powerful, being able to deploy six prongs simultaneously.

items.name: Holographic Crankshaft
items.desc:
Packed and separated data containers for holographic crankshafts.
Real crankshafts are frequently too large, noisy or hard-to-maintain for use in delicate machines. When faced with such a situation, high-tech manufacturers turn to these holographic substitutes.

items.name: Vector Compressors
items.desc:
A large crate of high-capacity vector compressors.
The creation of interstellar drives often requires dimensions to be condensed and then re-rendered. Such high-tech component manufacture would not be possible without industrial-grade compressors such as these.

items.name: Blood Salt
items.desc:
Jars of murky, foul-smelling crystals. Produced in viscous evaporation traps, these organic salts are used in the manufacture of illegal pheromones.
Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.
Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.name: Stolen DNA Samples
items.desc:
Sealed vials of unregistered DNA samples, free of the standard biosecurity mechanisms that prevent unlawful genetic tampering.
Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.
Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.name: Moon Ether
items.desc:
A vat of highly volatile liquid. Its fumes are extremely flammable and a function as a powerful sedative.
Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.
Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.name: Prismatic Feathers
items.desc:
A vacuum-sealed bundle of dazzlingly beautiful feathers. The animal that gave its life for this impossible, kaleidoscopic, charm is long since extinct.
Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.
Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.name: GrahGrah
items.desc:
A canister of the now-banned Vy'keen battle gas, traditionally inhaled on the eve of battle.
Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.
Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.name: Counterfeit Circuits
items.desc:
Reversed-engineered from a captured space station core, these unlicensed circuits are used in a wide range of black- and grey-market technologies.
Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.
Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.name: Banned Weapons
items.desc:
Hacked together from the salvaged remains of Sentinel forces, these potent weapons are a favourite of outlaws across the galaxy.
Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.
Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.name: First Spawn Relics
items.desc:
Relics of the fallen Gek empire, condemned and banned by all the galaxy's major civilisations.
Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.
Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.name: Hazard Protection
items.desc:
The Exosuit's Hazard Protection system continually monitors and stabilises the user's environment.
General reactive protection may be augmented with Environmental Shields, offering increased protection against specific conditions.
The device is charged with sodium-based substances. User is advised that a failure to charge the Hazard Protection system may allow their environment to become incompatible with life.

items.name: Shield Lattice
items.desc: Increases the base capacity of the Hazard Protection system, allowing the user to spend longer in hazardous environments without recharging their Exosuit.

items.name: Life Support
items.desc:
The core of the Exosuit, the Life Support System continually filters and pumps breathable Oxygen.
In addition to its role in the continued existence of the Exosuit user, the Life Support Unit uses surplus oxygen to generate power for secondary systems, such as the Jetpack, Speed Augmentation and Torch.

items.name: Oxygen Recycler
items.desc: Increases the base capacity of the Life Support system, allowing the user to go longer between charges.

items.name: Jetpack
items.desc:
Provides the Exosuit with advanced movement capabilities, including temporary flight.
Control thrust with JUMP. The flightpack uses energy from the Exosuit Life Support system to pressurise and vent bursts of gas, propelling the user into the air.
Jetpack can be temporarily overloaded by gathering Deuterium-rich plants, causing a dramatic increase in available thrust.

items.name: Neural Stimulator
items.desc: Increases the capacity of the Exosuit's Jetpack Tanks and Adrenal Pump Reserves, allowing the user to both fly and sprint longer.

items.name: Rocket Boots
items.desc:
Equips the Exosuit jetpack with advanced jump capabilities, allowing the user to take huge leaps with ease.
Activate jump systems by rapidly pressing JUMP.

items.name: Coolant Network
items.desc:
User is guarded from extreme heat damage on scorched worlds.
Provides relief from intense atmospheric and solar heat through a threaded dermal distribution network of liquid frenium.
Device is charged by mineral extracts found in hot environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

items.name: Thermic Layer
items.desc:
User is guarded from extreme cold damage on frozen worlds.
Heat capillaries threaded through a user's suit that evenly distributes liquid calidium to maintain a comfortable body temperature.
Device is charged by mineral extracts found in frozen environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

items.name: Toxic Suppressor
items.desc:
User is protected from toxic damage.
Reactive compounds within the Suppressor remove toxic liquids that fall on the user, thereby reducing peril and choking hazards.
Device is charged by mineral extracts found in toxic environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

items.name: Radiation Deflector
items.desc:
User is shielded from radiation damage.
Greatly reduces user peril during the exploration of irradiated worlds. Micro-vibrations increase electromagnetic wave reflection, thereby reducing absorption.
Device is charged by mineral extracts found in radioactive environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

items.name: Aeration Membrane
items.desc:
User is able to swim underwater for extended periods.
Absorbs gases dissolved in water through a membrane contactor that, if user is of a conventionally structured species, is placed over the mouth or facial breathing hole.
Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

items.name: Haz-Mat Gauntlet
items.desc:
Upgrades the metallic shielding of the Exosuit's gloves.
An advanced blend of reinforced metal and catalytic shielding allows the user to safely handle hazardous substances, as well as perform the necessary feats of strength required to harvest certain farmable flora.

items.name: Remembrance
items.desc: Everything you ever knew is within.

items.name: Star Seed
items.desc:
The smallest of sparks, housed within a containment field of unknown origins.
The seed glows with life, desperate to escape and fulfill its potential.

items.name: Obsolete Technology
items.desc:
A piece of technology, corrupted by interference from the Atlas.
Can be recycled for usable components.

items.name: Efficient Water Jets
items.desc:
Improves the fuel efficiency of the jetpack's marine jets, reducing the drain on Exosuit life support systems.
Aqueous compressor units are installed into the jetpack's turbines, bypassing the large energy requirements of underwater ignition.

items.name: Oxygen Rerouter
items.desc:
Upgrades the Aeration Membrane of the Exosuit to harvest oxygen from the Life Support system in the event of a breathing emergency, allowing the user to resurface and seek conventional fuel supplies.
Note: Long-term conversion of life support energy to breathable gas is not recommended, and may result in life no longer being supported.

items.name: Simple Translator
items.desc:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.
Low memory capacity on this entry-level model limits translation capacity.

items.name: Superior Translator
items.desc:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.
Parallel language processors enable a greater proportion of recorded speech to be translated.

items.name: Advanced Translator
items.desc:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.
A large memory array and overclocked language processors allow the real-time translation of significant chunks of speech.

items.name: Artemis' Translator
items.desc:
An automatic translation device. Device must be calibrated by pre-loading with existing translation data. Device must have network connection to Artemis to function.
Without access to host translation service, on-board circuit allows limited real-time translation of a small number of words.

items.name: Pulse Engine
items.desc:
Spaceflight propulsion, boosts and on-demand Pulse Jumps through local system.
User is advised that Tritium is required to charge Pulse Engine. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields. Locate Tritium with the starship scanner (SCAN).
Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

items.name: Photonix Core
items.desc: Provides increased manoeuvrability and longer boosts during spaceflight.

items.name: Launch Thruster
items.desc:
Vital launch and landing gear system.
User is advised that specialised, Deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation.
Hold THRUST to take off from planet.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

items.name: Efficient Thrusters
items.desc: Upgrades the starship launch systems, decreasing the fuel cost of takeoff.

items.name: Launch Auto-Charger
items.desc:
Photovoltaic panels fitted to the starship Launch Thrusters allow for a slow trickle charge while the ship is not in operation.
Harvested light is used to fuse di-hydrogen from the atmosphere and over time will refuel the Launch Thrusters automatically.

items.name: Teleport Receiver
items.desc:
A device that modulates standard starship communication signals to enable the transport of matter as well as data.
Starships fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's exosuit over a long distance.

items.name: Hyperdrive
items.desc:
FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through Galactic Map.

items.name: Cadmium Drive
items.desc:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class red stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

items.name: Emeril Drive
items.desc:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class green stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

items.name: Indium Drive
items.desc:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix,  preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class blue stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

items.name: Deflector Shield
items.desc:
Energy shield that protects spacecraft from laser fire, in-flight projectiles and accidental space debris interaction.
User is advised that catalytic elements are required to recharge device.
Operates automatically once constructed within user's starship inventory.

items.name: Ablative Armour
items.desc:
Adds a layer of superheated shielding to the starship's defense array, vaporising incoming fire.
Significantly increases starship shield performance.

items.name: Rocket Launcher
items.desc:
A long range starship weapon, capable of delivering a highly explosive torpedo across massive distances.
Note: explosive damage is highly effective against unshielded targets, but ineffective against shielded targets.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

items.name: Large Rocket Tubes
items.desc: Expands the loading chamber of the starship Rocket Launcher, improving exhaust performance and allowing for significantly faster heat recovery.

items.name: Photon Cannon
items.desc:
A destructive starship projectile launcher, the weapons system of choice for the interstellar trader and pirate alike.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

items.name: Economy Scanner
items.desc:
An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access detailed economic data about a system without having to visit. See collected data automatically on the Galaxy Map.
Active the scanner's internal Trade Computer with FE_ALT1 to search for highly-profitable trading surge events.

items.name: Conflict Scanner
items.desc: An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access conflict data in the galaxy map, without having to put themselves in harm's way.

items.name: Phase Beam
items.desc:
A high-energy beam weapon for ship-to-ship combat.
Though vulnerable to overheating, these highly accurate laser weapons can recharge the users's shields by leeching energy from target shield systems.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

items.name: Fourier De-Limiter
items.desc:
Rewires the Phase Beam with nanite-based circuitry, bypassing conventional reality limits on laser power.
Significantly improves heat performance.

items.name: Positron Ejector
items.desc:
A powerful starship weapon, capable of delivering extreme destruction at close range.
Note: these particles show decreased effectiveness against shielded targets.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

items.name: Fragment Supercharger
items.desc:
Overhauls the firing mechanism of the Positron Ejector, resulting in faster, more accurate particles.
Improves range and accuracy.

items.name: Infra-Knife Accelerator
items.desc:
A rapid fire starship weapon that launches superheated globes of liquid metal at hostile targets. These projectiles are extremely effective against unshielded starship hulls.
Note: the Accelerator's internal components are vulnerable to rapid overheating. Sustained burst fire is not recommended.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

items.name: Nonlinear Optics
items.desc:
Replaces the conventional Photon Cannon optics with an experimental glass array, boosting combat performance.
Significantly improves heat sink capacity.

items.name: Cyclotron Ballista
items.desc:
A powerful ship-to-ship weapon, flinging plasmatic balls of ionising radiation towards the selected target. These projectiles can disable starship engines, leaving the target vulnerable to attack from other weapons.
These charged particles are extremely effective against starship shields, and considerably weaker against the metal armour of a ship's hull.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

items.name: Dyson Pump
items.desc:
Replaces the heat sink of the Cyclotron Ballista by encompassing the entire unit with a heat-absorbing megastructure. Heat output is recycled to boost combat efficiency.
Significantly improves heat performance.

items.name: Freighter Hyperdrive
items.desc: FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.

items.name: Hull Fracture
items.desc:
Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.
Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

items.name: Rusted Circuits
items.desc:
Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.
Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

items.desc:
Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.
Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

items.name: Analysis Visor
items.desc:
Specialist Discovery and Survey unit.
Augments standard Scanner capabilities by projecting detailed environmental data directly over the user's visor. Allows the identification of distant points of interest.
The Visor will generate valuable data when used to study flora, fauna and minerals.
Hold AIM to operate. Press ZOOM to zoom.

items.name: Scanner
items.desc:
A Personal Surface Radar augmentation for the Multi-Tool.
The Scanner releases a high-energy pulse that reveals any critical survival resources in the immediate area. Data is transmitted via the Exosuit directly into the user's visual nervous system.
Press SCAN to activate a local scan.

items.name: Waveform Recycler
items.desc:
A powerful lateral processor inserted into the Multi-Tool Scanning System allows the device to recharge at a significantly improved rate.
Increases potential scan frequency.

items.name: Survey Device
items.desc:
A self-contained circuitry upgrade for the Analysis Visor, adding real-time terrain analysis to the scanning array.
Toggle between Visor modes with SURVEYFILTERL/SURVEYFILTERR. Use Surveying Mode to detect hidden terrain resources.

items.name: Terrain Manipulator
items.desc:
Advanced terraforming device. This module overloads existing multi-tool systems, allowing the user to reshape regions as they wish.
Charged with metallic elements.

items.name: Personal Forcefield
items.desc:
On activation, this module draws power from Exosuit Life Support systems to overload the Multi-Tool, distorting the electromagnetic field around the user and creating a powerful personal shield.
While this field offers substantial protection against incoming laser fire, the user is advised that the Multi-Tool cannot be used for other functions while powering the shield.

items.name: Combat Scope
items.desc: A recoil-stabilising weapon scope for precise combat.

items.name: Mining Beam
items.desc:
Multi-Tool Mining Beam powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK.
Installs focusing optics within the Multi-Tool, allowing it to emit a high-energy beam. The beam is calibrated to excite molecules within common organic or geological objects, allowing it to operate as a highly effective mining device.
WARNING: Destruction of flora, fauna or minerals may attract Sentinel attention.

items.name: Advanced Mining Laser
items.desc:
Replaces standard Mining Beam optics with high-grade Living Glass, allowing the beam to be effective against large and/or rare resource deposits.
The lens adapts automatically to minute fluctuations in the beam waveform, minimising scatter and increasing device mining potential.

items.name: Optical Drill
items.desc:
Wafer-thin lens arrays are arranged in a highly calibrated matrix, focusing the Mining Beam on an atomic level.
This extra precision allows for highly efficient mining. Elements are extracted more efficiently, increasing the yield from items harvested with the Multi-Tool.

items.name: Boltcaster
items.desc:
Generalist weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Boltcaster reconfigures the Multi-Tool to supercharge Metallic Elements, firing them as high-velocity projectiles capable of causing extreme damage.

items.name: Barrel Ioniser
items.desc:
Inserts a powerful field ionisation device into the barrel of the Boltcaster, increasing projectile stability through the air.
Improves device accuracy and allows the user to fire for longer periods without degrading combat performance.

items.name: Boltcaster SM
items.desc:
Boltcaster shots deliver added physical damage upon impact.
Grants additional kinetic energy to the user's ionised plasma distribution systems.
Operates automatically once constructed within user's Multi-Tool inventory.

items.name: Plasma Resonator
items.desc:
A significant upgrade for the Mining Beam.
Upgrades the Mining Laser's primary crystal chamber, boosting core beam energy while decreasing unwanted heat spill.

items.name: Plasma Launcher
items.desc:
High-impact projectile weapon. Launched plasma shells bounce off surfaces until their internal timer triggers a large explosion.
Charged with Unstable Plasma. Careless use can result in damage to user.
Press ALTATTACK to activate.

items.name: Geology Cannon
items.desc:
Large-bore projectile launcher. Propels plasma shells designed for rapid ground excavation.
Charged with Unstable Plasma. Warning: Explosive hole creation may also damage nearby organic matter.
Press ALTATTACK to activate.

items.name: Blaze Javelin
items.desc:
Aggressive weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Blaze Javelin delivers instantaneous damage on targets.
Plasma charge process creates an ionised gas arc to propel projectiles at great speed. User will perceive destructive results simultaneous to the pull of the trigger.

items.name: Mass Accelerator
items.desc:
Extends the firing chamber of the Blaze Javelin, allowing the internal particle accelerators to reach both greater mass and speed.
Significantly improves weapon damage.

items.name: Scatter Blaster
items.desc:
Specialist close combat weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Scatter Blaster reconfigures the Multi-Tool to heat and shatter Metallic Elements, firing them in a wide cone of destruction. Range is limited, but the shrapnel is highly effective at close range.

items.name: Shell Greaser
items.desc: Advanced self-lubricating components decrease friction within the Scatter Blaster, offering significant improvements to reload times.

items.name: Pulse Spitter
items.desc:
Specialist rapid fire weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Pulse Spitter redirects Multi-Tool optics to ionise inserted Metallic Elements. These projectiles are launched in a rapid-fire spread, bombarding potential targets with a wave of high-energy plasma.

items.name: Amplified Cartridges
items.desc:
Specialist harmonic resonators allow the Pulse Spitter to split inserted ammunition, effective manufacturing more shots from fewer materials.
Increases weapon clip size.

items.name: Short Circuit
items.desc:
Multi-Tool subsystem critically damaged.
Slot cannot be used until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.
Repairing will free slot up for general use.

items.name: Blown Transistor
items.desc:
Multi-Tool subsystem critically damaged.
Slot cannot be used until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.
Repairing will free slot up for general use.

items.desc:

items.desc:

items.name: Fusion Engine
items.desc:
A compact fusion core common to all Exocraft.
Requires fuel to function.

items.name: Drift Suspension
items.desc:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.
Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to drift.

items.name: Grip Boost Suspension
items.desc:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.
Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to turn sharply.

items.name: Hi-Slide Suspension
items.desc:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.
Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to slide.

items.name: Exocraft Radar
items.desc:
A large and complex field-based subspace radar.
Due to their large power consumption and inherent subatomic instability, they are found only installed on Exocraft.
Press QUICK_MENU to activate the Signal Booster.

items.name: Radar Power Resonator
items.desc: Allows for additional building types to be acquired by the Exocraft Radar.

items.name: Exocraft Boosters
items.desc: An efficient plasma injector coupled to the engine that allows short bursts of speed.

items.name: Exocraft Mining Laser
items.desc: A mining laser too cumbersome for handheld operation, they are found only installed on Exocraft.

items.name: Advanced Exocraft Laser
items.desc: Increases power of the Exocraft Mining Laser.

items.name: Mounted Cannon
items.desc: Due to the energy requirements of this powerful weapon, they can only be fired from an Exocraft mount.

items.name: Humboldt Drive
items.desc:
A thermally-efficient, inversion-proof reactor engine capable of powering the Nautilon even at extreme depths.
Powered by Hydrothermal Fuel Cells.

items.name: Nautilon Cannon
items.desc:
A mounted cannon specifically designed for the Nautilon Submarine.
A high-energy weapon system, it superheats a small body of water before launching it rapidly towards the intended target.
Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.

items.name: Tethys Beam
items.desc:
A mounted laser system specifically designed for the Nautilon Submarine.
Fires a concentrated plasma beam towards the intended target, which is then ignited. Such a trigger mechanism allows the use of high-energy optical mining systems in a liquid medium.

items.name: High-Power Sonar
items.desc:
A high-detail sonar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard a Nautilon-class submarine to Analysis Visor levels, pinning to the HUD all information typically revealed by the Analysis Visor.
Press SCAN to activate the High-Power Sonar.

items.name: Osmotic Generator
items.desc:
Installed into the drive system aboard the Nautilon Submarine.
Captures energy by exploiting the saline gradient in deep water environments, allowing a slow recharge of the Humboldt Drive in the event of fuel emergencies.

items.name: Locking mechanism
items.desc: A simple locking device, designed to keep out unauthorised pilferers. Damage has locked it permanently.

items.name: Magnetic Lock
items.desc: An advanced locking device. A polarity incident has caused it to seal shut permanently.

items.name: Superconductive Lock
items.desc: A highly advanced locking device. Damage to the circuits supplying the magnet has caused it to lock permanently.

items.name: Input terminal
items.desc: A terminal designed to allow manual control of the device. Damage prevents it actually receiving any input.

items.name: Bio-input sensor
items.desc: An advanced control unit, designed to allow device/flesh interaction. Damage prevents it functioning correctly. Interfacing while it is in this state is not advised.

items.name: Boiler Unit
items.desc: A small boiler, generating heat to allow the device to function in difficult climates. A malfunction has resulted in a damaging boiler overflow.

items.name: Tiny motor
items.desc: A very small motor, designed to power very small parts. It has corroded, and is full of very small rust.

items.name: Cooling system
items.desc: A pump and heat exchange system designed to keep the device from overheating. It has itself overheated, and is no longer functional.

items.name: Output screen
items.desc: A display terminal designed to communicate the device's status to the user. As the terminal is broken, the user cannot be made aware that the terminal is broken.

items.name: Tamper Prevention Device
items.desc: A unit designed to destroy vital systems in the event that the device is tampered with by an unauthorised party. Unfortunately, it has itself malfunctioned and will continue to damage other systems until repaired.

items.name: Security Alarm
items.desc: A small light/klaxon hybrid, designed to warn of unauthorised access to the device. Damage to the alarm has caused it to overload and short other nearby circuits.

items.name: Spring Casing
items.desc: The casing for a high-compression spring. The casing has ruptured, causing the spring to shoot out and damage the rest of the device.

items.name: Thermoregulator
items.desc: A control unit designed to keep temperatures even across the device. The sensor unit is damaged, causing it to vent or generate heat at inappropriate times.

items.name: Fuel Pump
items.desc: A high-capacity pump, ensuring that fuel reaches every part of the device in all gravitational conditions. The filter is clogged with a strange substance, causing it to lose power.

items.name: Servo Arm
items.desc: A small mechanical joint, used to correct small mechanical errors across the device. A malfunction is causing it to take functional components and push them into the wrong place, creating even more damage.

items.name: Solenoid
items.desc: A relay switch, intended to aid the powering up of the device. The connectors have become corroded, and the solenoid is no longer functioning.

items.name: Pressure Chamber
items.desc: A small pressurised chamber, designed to create the compressed gas necessary for the device to function. Cracks have appeared in the chamber, causing it to leak.

items.name: Master Circuit
items.desc: The control circuit for all the other components in the device. Damage to this circuitry is fatal.

items.name: Power Distributor
items.desc: The central power unit for the device. Damage to the unit means it is currently distributing all the power to one particular circuit, causing a dangerous short.

items.name: Load Balancer
items.desc: A small unit designed to regulate the flow of power across the device. A malfunction is causing it to short, damaging other components.

items.name: Network Interface
items.desc: A universal network interface, allowing the device to connect to a remote control centre. Damage to this interface is causing it to interpret background radiation as network signals, corrupting data in other circuits.

items.name: Safety Panel
items.desc: The safety panel seals off potentially dangerous components in the event of a malfunction. An over sensitive trigger has caused it to activate, preventing the device from operating.

items.name: Alternator
items.desc: The alternator generates and regulates power for the device. A strange corrosion seeps through it, preventing it from working.

items.name: Photovoltaic Panel
items.desc: A small but efficient panel, designed to harvest light and convert it to power. However, the panel is now cracked and dusty, and can no longer be relied on.

items.name: Transmission Box
items.desc: The gearing mechanism for the device. The lubricant that keeps it operational appears to have been replaced with an otherworldly green goo, and the gears are now stuck.

items.name: Ancient Lock
items.desc: A mysterious lock with several keyholes, this relic protects what must surely be a valuable treasure.

items.name: Pearl Offering
items.desc: The chest requires a Living Pearl, harvested from the giant mother-molluscs that grow on the ocean floor.

items.name: Damaged Electrode
items.desc:
This Exosuit Upgrade Module is critically damaged. Repair systems to restore upgrade functionality.
If repaired, User will not be charged for any Exosuit Upgrades.

items.name: Shattered Power Core
items.desc:
This Exosuit Upgrade Module is critically damaged. Repair systems to restore upgrade functionality.
If repaired, User will not be charged for any Exosuit Upgrades.

items.name: Faulty Hologram
items.desc:
This Exosuit Upgrade Module is critically damaged. Repair systems to restore upgrade functionality.
If repaired, User will not be charged for any Exosuit Upgrades.

items.name: Warp Core Resonator
items.desc:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.
Quantum resonation improves the robustness of the drive during FTL travel, granting the ability to leap to stars previously out of reach.

items.name: Plasmatic Warp Injector
items.desc:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.
Hyperdrive benefits from advanced fusion that brings starship to higher warp speed and intensity. User's craft will become able to leap deeper into space, and into more distant planetary systems.

items.name: Reality De-Threader
items.desc:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.
Uncapped, yet stabilised, fusion systems are threaded into user's hyperdrive. Allows starship to jump ever longer distances in deep space.

items.name: Amplified Warp Shielding
items.desc:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class red stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

items.name: Chromatic Warp Shielding
items.desc:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class green stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

items.name: Temporal Warp Computer
items.desc:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix,  preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class blue stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

items.name: Airburst Engine
items.desc:
A powerful upgrade for the Exosuit Jetpack, allowing limited jetpack recharging while airborne.
Highly efficient compressors fitted around the jetpack exhaust take advantage of the windflow generated by persistent falling, recycling some of that energy into jetpack fuel.

items.name: Personal Refiner
items.desc:
A compact extension to the Exosuit, installing a small Portable Refiner, accessible directly from the user's Exosuit interface.
Unit requires fuel and is limited to refining one substance at a time.

items.name: Instability Drive
items.desc:
A highly-advanced upgrade for the Pulse Engine, vastly increasing fuel efficiency.
Tritium supplies are redirected into a cycle of miniature black holes. Resulting micro-gravity fluctuations are harnessed to boost starship propulsion beyond conventional combustion-based approaches.

items.name: Sub-Light Amplifier
items.desc:
A highly-advanced upgrade for the Pulse Engine, vastly increasing interplanetary speed.
Naturally occuring frameshift effects within the Pulse Engine are amplified by tritium-based resonators, increasing its maximum sub-light speed.

items.name: Emergency Warp Unit
items.desc:
A significant upgrade to the Hyperdrive that allows an instantaneous warp even while conventional systems are blocked by starship combat. Access to the emergency warp system is via the Quick Menu.
WARNING: Fast scramble systems mean the user is unable to plot a destination. Uncalculated lightspeed events will damage the unit and require frequent repairs.

items.name: Q-Resonator
items.desc: Upgrades the Infra-Knife Accelerator, compressing internal waveforms to allow an extra shot to be weaved in to the conventional fire patterns.

items.name: Hydraulics Damage
items.desc:
Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.
Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

Slot cannot be used until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.

items.name: Pulsing Heart
items.desc:
A fibrous metallic superstructure binds this warm and vital organ with the core of the ship. Without it, the ship would be nothing, a lifeless husk.
Hold PULSEJUMP to ask the heart to initiate a Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to request a speed boost.

items.name: Neural Assembly
items.desc:
An array of distributed neurons, fused to a board of metallic strands. Complex patterns of electrical impulses weave their way across the surface, knotting each ship system together.
Hold THRUST to inquire if the ship would like to take off.

items.name: Singularity Cortex
items.desc:
A complex bio-metallic stem plugged directly into an antimatter heart. Registers high activity during interstellar jumps. It appears to delight in the complex calculations required for FTL travel.
Access long-distance navigation systems through Galactic Map. Keep the ship happy by regularly jumping between systems.

items.name: Scream Suppressor
items.desc:
This small extension to the ship's automated defense network appears to be its own autonomous organism. A small mouth in the centre of its flesh hungers for Pugneum.
During combat, it seems to hijack the neurological array and prevent fear or pain from traumatising the rest of the ship's body.

items.name: Spewing Vents
items.desc:
A mess of sacs and sphincters, these vents generate and expel globules of plasma. When fused to the weapon systems of the ship, these are super-heated and then expelled at high-pressure.
Press SHIPFIRE to ask if the ship would direct its vents towards the current target.

items.name: Grafted Eyes
items.desc:
A complex arrangement of membranes and lens, fused atop a high-energy laser array. Incineration awaits those that meet their stare.
Press SHIPFIRE request the eyes gaze upon nearby targets.

items.name: Matter Beam
items.desc:
A device that modulates standard freighter communication signals to enable the interplanetary transport of matter as well as data.
Freighters fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's Exosuit over a long distance.

items.name: Solar Ray
items.desc:
A highly specialised addition to the Multi-Tool's mining capabilities, transforming terrain deposits into liquid sun.
A powerful laser array amplifies local solar radiation, allowing for the rapid reconfiguration of nearby mineral ores.

items.name: Animus Beam
items.desc:
A unique overload to the Multi-Tool's standard mining laser. Beam frequency is modulated precisely in a feedback loop with the delta-waves generated by the impact target.
Recordings of the target's experiences are thus etched into tiny fragments of metal and rendered as Fragmented Qualia. Readability of collected fragments is not guaranteed.

items.name: Thermal Buffer
items.desc:
Sublimation cooling vents and high-thermal mass buffers are installed in all structural panels, keeping the Exocraft pilot at non-lethal temperatures even in the most overwhelming of firestorms.
Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in scorched environments.

items.name: Megawatt Heater
items.desc:
Installs a powerful heater into the Exocraft, keeping the cabin a habitable temperature even in the most freezing of conditions.
Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in freezing environments.

items.name: Air Filtration Unit
items.desc:
Double-vacuumed air filtration systems allow no trace of the planetary atmosphere into the Exocraft cabin without being thoroughly scrubbed.
Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in toxic environments.

items.name: Neutron Shielding
items.desc:
Highly-efficient control materials are inserted into the frame of the Exocraft, neutralising dangerous incoming energy waves.
Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in radioactive environments.

items.name: Icarus Fuel System
items.desc:
The Icarus system takes advantage of existing metal panelling, upgrading them into photovoltaic surfaces. This reactive coating generates energy during daylight hours, offsetting fuel consumption.
Enables automatic engine recharging during the day.

items.name: Radar Amplifier
items.desc: Allows for additional building types to be acquired by the Exocraft Radar.

items.name: Daedalus Engine
items.desc:
A compact reactor unit, this engine is the heart of the Minotaur. It is mounted on a gyroscope to prevent fuel incidents during rapid movement.
Powered by conventional carbon-base fuels.

items.name: Self-Greasing Servos
items.desc:
An automatically-regulated lubricant dispenser fitted to the leg joints of the Minotaur reduce friction and encourage fuel-efficient motion.
Significantly reduces fuel burn in the Minotaur's Daedalus Engine.

items.name: Minotaur Radar Array
items.desc:
A high-detail radar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard the Minotaur to Analysis Visor levels.
Press SCAN to activate a radar sweep, revealing additional points of interest that cannot be located via a Multi-Tool scanner.
Use the Quick Menu to tune the radar to specific buildings.

items.name: Ariadne's Flame
items.desc:
A series of agile, high-powered jet thrusters mounted to the rear of the rear of the Minotaur. Precise use allows the Minotaur to quickly and powerfully traverse all manner of terrain.
Press and hold JUMP to activate. Limited in-flight control is possible.

items.name: Minotaur Laser
items.desc:
A mounted laser system specifically designed for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.
Enables conventional mining operations. Ineffective in combat scenarios.

items.name: Precision Minotaur Laser
items.desc:
An upgrade for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid's laser array system.
Amplifies the power deployed by the mining beam, increasing mining speed and enabling the processing of difficult to mine raw materials.

items.name: Minotaur Cannon
items.desc:
A mounted cannon specifically designed for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.
Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.

items.name: Minotaur Bore
items.desc:
Adds Terrain Manipulation capability to the laser array of the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.
A special mount allows the rapid deployment of a high-energy terrain excavator, without risking clogging the Minotaur's delicate joints and servos with dirt.

items.name: Environment Control Unit
items.desc:
This powerful environmental neutralising system is plugged directly into the pilot as they enter the cockpit. The system is powered via the Minotaur's main engine and requires no additional input. Some minor pain may be noticed around the insertion site.
Renders the Minotaur pilot impervious to all environmental hazards.

items.name: Boltcaster Ricochet Module
items.desc:
Creates an antimatter field around the shots of the Boltcaster, causing them to be repelled by non-damaged surfaces.
Enables ricochet, causing projectiles to bounce if they hit a target they do not damage.

items.name: Pulse Spitter Ricochet Module
items.desc:
Creates an antimatter field around the shots of the Pulse Spitter, causing them to be repelled by non-damaged surfaces.
Enables ricochet, causing projectiles to bounce if they hit a target they do not damage.

items.name: Incinerator
items.desc:
Specialist high temperature weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Incinerator focuses internal lasers onto the naturally-occuring exhaust gases generated by the Multi-Tool. Ignition results in a highly destructive, if short range, inferno.

items.name: Advanced Launch System
items.desc:
A custom-made launch control system for high-performance starships. Sensitive gyroscopes and specialised control circuits plot custom take-off routines for increased launch speed and efficiency.
Specialised, deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation.
Hold THRUST to take off from planet. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

items.name: Waveform Engine
items.desc:
A highly-tuned version of the conventional starship Pulse Engine. Wavefront occupancy has been pushed to the limit, creating a pulse experience that is both efficient and highly responsive.
User is advised that Tritium is required to charge the drive. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields. Scan (SHIPSCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.
Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

items.name: Frameshift Catapult
items.desc:
This experimental drive augments conventional hyperdrive technology by distorting local geometry at the point of warp initialisation, boosting range and efficiency far beyond standard drives.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through the Galactic Map.

items.name: Pressurisation Capsule
items.desc:
A critical starship safety feature, vital for extra-orbital flight.
The pressuration capsule is a dedicated unit that both ensures a breathable atmosphere and prevents the catastrophic explosion of unconventional cockpit designs.

items.name: Visceral Synthesiser
items.desc:
A piece of otherworldy technology. Its inviting membranes are soft, gel-like, pulsing with a gentle crimson radiance.
Its warm embrace allows the user to extricate any Vile Spawn from the embryotic sacs of Hungering Tendrils.

items.name: Archive Bypass Implant
items.desc:
A biotechnical firewall, developed as a safeguard against textual cognitohazards. It is coated in something slippery, and has started to bubble along the surface.
Embedded beneath the skin, this grants administrative access to ancient forbidden texts bound at a Planetary Archive.
Warning: Do not unbind the forbidden texts. Exposure to forbidden texts carries extreme risk.

items.name: Solenoid
items.desc: A relay switch, intended to aid the powering up of the device. The connectors have become corroded, and the solenoid is no longer functioning.

items.name: Tiny motor
items.desc: A very small motor, designed to power very small parts. It has corroded, and is full of very small rust.

items.name: Cooling system
items.desc: A pump and heat exchange system designed to keep the device from overheating. It has itself overheated, and is no longer functional.

items.name: Thermoregulator
items.desc: A control unit designed to keep temperatures even across the device. The sensor unit is damaged, causing it to vent or generate heat at inappropriate times.

items.name: Servo Arm
items.desc: A small mechanical joint, used to correct small mechanical errors across the device. A malfunction is causing it to take functional components and push them into the wrong place, creating even more damage.

items.name: Pressure Chamber
items.desc: A small pressurised chamber, designed to create the compressed gas necessary for the device to function. Cracks have appeared in the chamber, causing it to leak.

items.name: Master Circuit
items.desc: The control circuit for all the other components in the device. Damage to this circuitry is fatal.

items.name: Power Distributor
items.desc: The central power unit for the device. Damage to the unit means it is currently distributing all the power to one particular circuit, causing a dangerous short.

items.name: Transmission Box
items.desc: The gearing mechanism for the device. The lubricant that keeps it operational appears to have been replaced with an otherworldly green goo, and the gears are now stuck.

items.name: Photovoltaic Panel
items.desc: A small but efficient panel, designed to harvest light and convert it to power. However, the panel is now cracked and dusty, and can no longer be relied on.

items.name: Trident Key
items.desc: The chest requires a Trident Key, given to those who study the mysterious sites in the deep ocean.

items.name: Cloaking Device
items.desc:
On activation, this module draws power from Exosuit Life Support systems to manipulate the gravitational field around the user, refracting the light and creating an active camouflage effect.
This temporary effect can be used to escape unwanted hostile attention. WARNING: active camouflage will be aborted upon dramatic Exosuit manoeuvres such as jetpack activation, or by activating Multi-Tool weapons systems.

items.name: Paralysis Mortar
items.desc:
Non-violent projectile weapon. Launched projectiles will incapacitate nearby targets with a burst of electrical energy. Effective against both biological and electronic entities.
Charged with Unstable Plasma.
Press ALTATTACK to activate.

items.name: Waveform Oscillator
items.desc:
Overloads the energy beam generated by the Blaze Javelin, causing it to deliver a power electrical charge at its point of impact.
Will briefly stun any organic and inorganic entities that intersect the Blaze Javelin's beam.

items.name: Impact Igniter
items.desc:
A powerful combat upgrade for the Pulse Spitter. This module installs series of delicately calibrated fuel-injection nozzles within the firing chamber, which are used to initiate a controlled burn within its plasma projectiles.
Causes targets hit by the Pulse Spitter to burn for a short while, causing additional damage.

items.name: Neutron Cannon
items.desc:
A high-energy weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. The Neutron Cannon energises atmospheric particles before propelling them towards hostile targets, delivering significant area damage
Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON. Charge the weapon with ATTACK, then release to unleash a volley of ionised particles.
While the cannon can deliver instantaneous single shots, longer charges will result in significant increases to the speed and volume of released particles.

items.name: P-Field Compressor
items.desc:
A powerful upgrade to the Neutron Cannon. Additional resonance compressors allow significantly more energy to be routed through the cannon's central core, dramatically increasing operating power.
Installation will allow a fully-charged Neutron Cannon to launch additional projectiles at higher speeds.

items.name: Voltaic Amplifier
items.desc:
A generalised upgrade for all Multi-Tool weapon systems, causing its projectiles to resonate dramatically upon impact with any appropriate electromagnetic field.
Will significantly increase the damage dealt to any organic and inorganic entities that are currently stunned.

items.name: Minotaur AI Pilot
items.desc:
A semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin for the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator.
The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.
Piloting routines are highly localised. It is incapable of developing emotional bonds nor exercising independent control of the Minotaur.

items.name: Hardframe Left Arm
items.desc:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.
When installed alongside a Minotaur Laser, it transforms the mining laser into a powerful combat upgrade with the ability to deal heavy damaged to stunned entities.

items.name: Hardframe Right Arm
items.desc:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.
This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system. It deploys high-velocity stun projectiles and serves as an excellent support weapon to the Minotaur's primary cannon.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.

items.name: Hardframe Legs
items.desc:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.
Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's engine and mobility systems.

items.name: Hardframe Body
items.desc:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.
Will function as a semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator.
The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

items.name: Cargo Scan Deflector
items.desc:
A specially tuned resonance jammer, designed to interfere with the remote cargo scans deployed by system authorities in the search for smuggled goods.
Deploy from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) while a scan is in progress to deflect the probe. Note: jamming is not 100% effective.

items.name: Sputtering Starship Trail
items.desc:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.
A ramshackle ship exhaust nozzle, hand-assembled in an emergency by an outlaw. Has an occasional propensity to explode, but with no adverse effect on flight handling.
Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

items.name: Vesper Sail
items.desc:
A high-performance solar sail, deployed automatically during flight. This advanced propulsion device generates an electric field within the sails themselves, allowing the starship to build momentum from the solar wind.
Offers substantial gains in fuel efficiency and boost performance over conventional engine systems, as well as enabling photovoltaic recharge of the starship's launch systems.

items.name: Temporal Starship Trail
items.desc:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.
A cosmic resonance chamber interacts with starship exhaust, modifying propulsion energy to leave a streak of temporal disturbances.
Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

items.name: Flight Assist Override
items.desc:
This grey-market electronics module disables critical safety and pilot-assistance modules usually baked into the starship's fly-by-wire control system. Despite its dubious legal status and its implication in a series of high-speed asteroid impacts, this module remains popular with smugglers, mercenaries, and others who think of themselves as advanced pilots.
Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the starship to drift during spaceflight.

items.name: Interstellar Scanner
items.desc:
An upgrade to the freighter's galactic-scale sensors.
This device allows the user to access detailed economic and conflict data for a system, even without having previously visited.

items.name: Singularity Engine
items.desc:
An unstable and highly-experimental piece of freighter hyperdrive technology. This extreme gravity device generates a wormhole deep within the freighter's reactor core, inverting the entire vessel and transporting it across the universe.
Speak to the freighter's commander to engage the drive. Warning: destination is not controllable.

items.name: Atmospheric Control Unit
items.desc:
A critical freighter subsystem, vital for maintaining a habitable and safe environment for all on-board organic lifeforms.
Capable of generated a limited breathable atmosphere even when damaged or unpowered, but only for a short period of time.

items.name: Neural Shielding
items.desc:
A beautiful living weave of nanotubes, laced through the vessel's neural assembly. This structure can be energised as the ship deems fit, creating a field that blocks hostile cargo probes.
Use the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) while a scan is in progress to ask that the ship might block the scan.

items.name: Chloroplast Membrane
items.desc:
An infusion of cyanobacteria fills the membrane, which rests just beneath the ship's translucent dermal layer.
The membrane will recharge the Neural Assembly automatically when exposed to sunlight.

items.name: Wormhole Brain
items.desc:
The wormhole brain permits the ship vision of systems far beyond its own experience.  It consists of strands of neural matter, wrapped around a micro-singularity and tethered directly to the ship's visual cortex.
Detailed economic and conflict data will become available on the Galaxy Map, should the ship permit it.

items.name: Extractor Unit
items.desc:
Gathers resources directly from the interstellar medium, via a complex system of suction intakes and condensing tubes. The gathered substance varies with the local star classification.
Powered directly from the freighter's main electrical loop. Functionality is entirely autonomous.

items.name: Trade Rocket
items.desc:
A personal rocketry device with a direct link to the Galactic Trade Network. This unit allows the user to load a small spacecraft with goods. Upon launch, the goods will be transported to the nearest trade terminus and automatically sold.
Summon the Trade Rocket using the QUICK_MENU.

items.name: Starship Scanner
items.desc: Starship Scanner

items.name: Anti-Gravity Well
items.desc:
Gently detaches the starship from gravitational fields, lifting it toward the stars.
The well hungers for pugneum or radiant shards, and must be sufficiently fueled before launch.
Hold THRUST to take off from planet.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

items.name: Luminance Engine
items.desc:
Aligns the ship's electromagnetic emissions with A T L A S waves, providing basic propulsion and Pulse Jump capability.
The sub-light drive hungers for tritium or radiant shards.
Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

items.name: Crimson Core
items.desc:
A raw optic organ, red and unblinking. Suspended above the ship's engines, it gazes down tunnels in spacetime, allowing FTL travel between star systems.
Direct the core's attention to remote destinations via the Galactic Map.

items.name: Aeron Shield
items.desc:
A defensive crimson cocoon, obfuscating the ship's physical form and providing protection from collision and laser fire.
The core self-heals over time, but may be quickly replenished with catalytic elements or radiant shards.

items.name: Sentinel Cannon
items.desc:
Sentinel-grade weapons system, engineered for the singular purpose of annihilating rogue ships in violation of system regulations.
Press SHIPFIRE to administer lethal force.

items.name: Pilot Interface
items.desc:
This device allows a pilot's brain to interface with the mind of the Sentinel Interceptor, granting the pilot access to ship control systems and external sensors.
The enmeshing of the pilot's mind with that of the vessel is necessary to prevent rejection/consumption of the pilot by the ship's vestigial cockpit.

items.name: Sentience Resistor
items.desc:
This Multi-Tool is a piece of hybrid technology, a fusion of crude scrap and a deep, powerful energy - part salvage, part Sentinel, part something undefinable...
This process of recycled fusion was incomplete when this tool was acquired. Use REPAIR to continue repair operations and free this slot for general use.

items.name: Discordant Prism
items.desc:
This Multi-Tool is a piece of hybrid technology, a fusion of crude scrap and a deep, powerful energy - part salvage, part Sentinel, part something undefinable...
This process of recycled fusion was incomplete when this tool was acquired. Use REPAIR to continue repair operations and free this slot for general use.

items.name: Corrupted Lens
items.desc:
This Multi-Tool is a piece of hybrid technology, a fusion of crude scrap and a deep, powerful energy - part salvage, part Sentinel, part something undefinable...
This process of recycled fusion was incomplete when this tool was acquired. Use REPAIR to continue repair operations and free this slot for general use.

items.name: Drained Power Core
items.desc:
This Multi-Tool is a piece of hybrid technology, a fusion of crude scrap and a deep, powerful energy - part salvage, part Sentinel, part something undefinable...
This process of recycled fusion was incomplete when this tool was acquired. Use REPAIR to continue repair operations and free this slot for general use.

items.name: Hijacked Laser
items.desc:
This Multi-Tool is made with material and methods known to no conventional manufacturer, its core a unfathomable array of impossible optics and glassy foam. Nonetheless, there is a layer of recogniseable technology. It shows signs of having been tampered with by an unknown craftsman, who has repurposed its scanner array into a high-powered mining laser.
Powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK.

items.name: Resonance Amplifier
items.desc:
An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner, designed by Specialist Polo for the detection of atlantideum-infused sentience echoes.
On dissonant worlds, use the Analysis Visor (AIM) to locate sentience echoes. On arrival at an echo site, use SCAN to fully reveal nearby anomalies.

items.name: Glyph One
items.desc:
A solemn power radiates from this ancient carving. Though the imagery is simple and the rendering rough, the meaning of the glyph has mathematical precision.
The glyph burns with a resonant energy in the presence of Atlantideum

items.name: Glyph Two
items.desc:
A solemn power radiates from this ancient carving. Though the imagery is simple and the rendering rough, the meaning of the glyph has mathematical precision.
The glyph burns with a resonant energy in the presence of Atlantideum

items.name: Glyph Three
items.desc:
A solemn power radiates from this ancient carving. Though the imagery is simple and the rendering rough, the meaning of the glyph has mathematical precision.
The glyph burns with a resonant energy in the presence of Atlantideum

items.name: Personal Refiner Mk 2
items.desc:
A compact extension to the Exosuit, installing an advanced yet portable Medium Refiner, accessible directly from the user's Exosuit interface.
Unit requires fuel and is able to refine more complex recipes than the standard personal refiner unit.

items.name: Scan Harmoniser
items.desc:
An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units.
Use SCAN to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal any nearby Autophage entities.

items.name: Polyphonic Core
items.desc:
An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units.
Use SCAN to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal any nearby Autophage entities.
In addition, this device can be used to locate Autophage gatherings. Use Locate Autophage Camp (FE_SELECT) to pinpoint a planetary gathering of Autophage.

items.name: Runic Lens
items.desc:
The geometric heart of this ancient weapon is the Runic Lens. Its impossible geometry not only concentrates light into a high-powered Mining Laser, but can also warp the local electromagnetic field so as to render the user invisible.
Powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK. Select its secondary cloaking function with CYCLEALTWEAPON and hold ALTATTACK to activate.

items.name: Phalanged Node
items.desc:
This autophage is far from working order, but its subcomponents shows the signs of a previous repair attempt. With a few additional tweaks, the work might be completed...
Repair this component with REPAIR, or use PIN to locate the needed materials.

items.name: Pressure Seal
items.desc:
This autophage is far from working order, but its subcomponents shows the signs of a previous repair attempt. With a few additional tweaks, the work might be completed...
Repair this component with REPAIR, or use PIN to locate the needed materials.
